column3: GARGANTUAN (body ~20 m long, its head alone is larger than a person). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A colossal ancient red dragon with crimson scales darkening to near-black at the edges, two great swept-back horns, a spiked jaw frill and a long spined tail, rears up on a volcanic crag with its vast batlike wings spread wide, neck raised high, roaring a towering column of fire UP into the smoky sky as a display of dominance. Far below in the lower right foreground two tiny adventurers (a fighter with a shield and a robed caster with a staff) seen from behind stand their ground on a stone ledge, looking up at it. Setting: smoky volcanic lair with glowing lava rivulets and drifting embers; four legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (a floating sphere about 2.5 m across). SOLO. A beholder in its carved underground lair: a floating spherical body with mottled purple-brown chitinous hide, ONE huge central eye glaring forward, a wide mouth of jagged fangs below it, and EXACTLY ten thin writhing eyestalks rising from the top of the sphere, each tipped with a small eye. Three of the eyestalks fire thin colored rays (green, crimson, pale violet) from their TIPS toward a shattering stone column on the right; the central eye casts a faint cone of pale antimagic light. Setting: a smooth-walled spiral cavern with vertical shafts, scattered petrified statues of adventurers at its base for scale; no limbs, it floats.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. In a dusty torch-lit crypt, a human skeleton warrior in scraps of rusted chain mail and a dented helm lunges forward out of an opened stone sarcophagus, a notched rusty shortsword raised in one bony hand and a cracked wooden shield on the other forearm; its empty eye sockets hold faint cold pinpoints of light. Two or three more skeletons climb out of niches behind it in the gloom. At the lower right edge, a single adventurer seen from behind raises a torch and a mace, the torchlight throwing long shadows of the skeletons across the vault. Every skeleton has exactly two arms and two legs, dry bones, no flesh.

MEDIUM (human-sized, tall and gaunt). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A mind flayer stands in a dim violet-lit underground corridor: a tall slender humanoid with glossy mauve-purple rubbery skin, a bulbous octopus-like head with pupil-less pale white eyes and FOUR long writhing tentacles hanging from its mouth, wearing a high-collared dark robe; two arms with long-fingered three-jointed hands. It raises one clawed hand and unleashes a Mind Blast: a rippling cone of distorted violet psychic force rolling toward the right. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind staggers, clutching their head, sword lowered. Setting: alien curved stone architecture of the Underdark, faint glowing fungi; no gore.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A lich stands at the heart of its ruined arcane sanctum: a gaunt skeletal mage with dry parchment-gray skin stretched over its skull, burning pinpoints of cold blue light in its eye sockets, a tarnished jeweled crown, and tattered rich purple-and-black robes with gold trim. One bony hand clutches a long rigid staff topped with a dark crystal; the other hand is thrust forward, hurling a crackling burst of sickly green necrotic energy toward the right. A small glowing phylactery box rests on a pedestal nearby. Setting: crumbling vaulted hall with toppled bookshelves and drifting dust motes, green light from below; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A vampire noble descends a moonlit castle staircase: pale gray-white skin, sharp aristocratic features, swept-back dark hair, glowing red eyes, elongated canine fangs bared, wearing an elegant high-collared black-and-crimson doublet and a flowing dark cloak. One clawed hand is raised in a commanding gesture its eyes glowing with a faint red hypnotic shimmer. Wisps of mist and a few bats swirl around its cloak. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind holds up a silver holy symbol, standing firm. Setting: gothic stone hall with tall arched windows, cold blue moonlight and red candlelight.

GARGANTUAN (about 15 m tall and 25 m long; adventurers barely reach its ankle). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. The tarrasque, a colossal scaled reptilian titan standing upright on two massive legs, with a heavy armored reflective carapace on its back, two great forward-curving horns on its head, a huge fanged maw, two short powerful clawed arms and a long spiked tail. It strides through a ruined city wall, bellowing with jaws wide open, shaking the ground so towers crumble. In the lower right foreground three tiny adventurers seen from behind stand on rubble, dwarfed. Setting: burning ruined town, dust clouds, collapsing stone walls for scale; two legs, two arms, one head, one tail.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall standing). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An owlbear rears up on its hind legs in a misty forest clearing: a massive bear body covered in a mix of thick brown fur and layered owl feathers, an owl head with a huge sharp hooked beak and large round amber eyes, feathered tufts above the eyes, and powerful forelimbs with long curved claws. It roars-screeches with beak wide open, claws raised to rend. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind backs away with a spear held level. Setting: old-growth forest with mossy boulders and shafts of light; four limbs, no wings.

LARGE (a cube about 3 m on each side, filling a dungeon corridor floor to ceiling). SOLO. A gelatinous cube glides silently down a narrow stone dungeon corridor: a perfect cube of nearly transparent, faintly greenish-cyan quivering jelly with soft highlights on its flat faces and edges. Suspended inside it, slowly dissolving, are bones, a rusty helmet, coins, a sword and a lantern still glowing faintly. It advances toward the right, its leading face bulging slightly, leaving a gleaming clean path on the flagstones behind it. Setting: torch-lit flagstone corridor with an iron-banded door for scale; no face, no eyes, no limbs.

MEDIUM (the size of a large treasure chest). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A mimic disguised as an ornate wooden treasure chest with iron bands springs to life in a dusty dungeon vault. It keeps the clear, symmetric shape of a chest: the lid hinges open at the back like a jaw, and the opening becomes ONE big mouth whose upper and lower rims are lined with a regular row of jagged teeth, a long sticky pink tongue lolling out over the front edge. Wood grain turns fleshy only along the inner rims of the mouth and at the hinges; the outside stays a believable chest with iron bands, a keyhole and corner fittings. NO arms, NO pseudopods, NO limbs, NO tentacles, NO eyes. An adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, steps back with a drawn shortsword: one straight, rigid steel blade of even width with a simple crossguard and grip, held firmly in one hand, its tip a hand's breadth from the tongue. Setting: treasure room with scattered coins, cobwebs and a lantern on the floor for scale.

GARGANTUAN (body as big as a warship, tentacles over 30 m). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A kraken rises from a storm-tossed sea: an immense squid-like titan with a ridged dark green-gray mantle, enormous glowing yellow eyes, a huge hooked beak, and ten colossal tentacles lined with suckers. Several colossal tentacles rear up out of the waves around a two-masted sailing ship on the right, poised above it, while lightning arcs from the storm clouds down toward the kraken's raised tentacle. Tiny sailors seen from behind stand firm on deck with harpoons and boathooks. Setting: towering waves, dark storm sky, rain; the ship gives scale.

LARGE (about 3.5 m tall). SOLO. A pit fiend, a lord of the Nine Hells, stands on a basalt throne dais: a massive muscular devil with scaly crimson skin, a fanged bestial face with curving horns, enormous bat-like wings wrapped half open like a cloak, a long thick tail, and two arms. One clawed hand grips a heavy flanged iron mace wreathed in hellfire; the other hand conjures a roaring ball of hellfire aimed toward the right. Setting: infernal fortress hall of black iron and stone, rivers of fire below, drifting ash; two arms, two legs, two wings, one tail.

HUGE (about 4 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A balor demon looms out of a burning abyssal chasm: a towering muscular fiend with dark red-black skin wreathed in roaring flames, a horned bestial head with blazing eyes, vast leathery bat wings spread wide. In its right hand a long flaming whip with multiple burning tails cracks high in the air above its head; in its left a jagged lightning-crackling sword is held low. Two adventurers seen from behind stand at the lower right on a cracked stone bridge. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the balor's feet, and the balor is only about 2.3 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its hip) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate. Setting: abyssal cavern, lava, black smoke; two arms, two legs, two wings.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A shambling zombie lurches forward through a foggy village graveyard at night: a dead human with gray-green waxy skin, sunken empty eyes, slack jaw, matted hair and tattered burial clothes, arms outstretched, fingers clawing. Behind it a few more zombies drag themselves between leaning gravestones in the mist. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind holds up a lantern and a short sword. Eerie and dry rather than rotting: no gore, no open wounds. Setting: crooked gravestones, a chapel silhouette, cold moonlight; every zombie two arms, two legs.

SMALL (about 1 m tall, waist height of a human). SOLO. A goblin warrior springs from behind a mossy rock on a forest trail: a scrawny small humanoid with greenish-yellow skin, large pointed ears, a wide mouth of small sharp teeth, flat nose and glinting yellow eyes, wearing patched leather armor and a ragged hood. It leaps forward with a curved scimitar in one hand, a shortbow slung across its back. Setting: forest path at dusk, a cart wheel and a human-height signpost behind it as scale cues; two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 2.7 m tall, gangly). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A troll charges out of a swamp: a lanky hunched giant with rubbery mottled green skin, long thin arms ending in wicked clawed hands, a long hooked nose, a mane of matted dark hair and small black eyes. It lunges forward with both clawed hands reaching, a half-healed wound on its shoulder visibly knitting closed. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind brandishes a flaming torch. Setting: misty bog with dead trees and reeds; the adventurer reaches its chest; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A medusa stands in the overgrown courtyard of a ruined temple: a woman with pale green scaled skin and serpentine yellow eyes glowing with petrifying power, a mass of writhing hissing green and brown snakes instead of hair, wearing tattered elegant draped robes, a longbow slung on her back. She raises one clawed hand and turns her glowing gaze toward the right; nearby a weathered stone statue of an adventurer frozen mid-step gives scale. Setting: broken columns, ivy, other petrified statues in frightened poses, golden light; two arms, two legs.

HUGE (body like an elephant, necks about 6 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A hydra rises from a swamp lake: a massive reptilian body with dark green-bronze scales and four stocky clawed legs, and EXACTLY five long serpentine necks, each ending in a fanged reptilian head; all five heads strike and hiss in different directions, one lunging toward the right. Two small adventurers seen from behind wade in the shallows at the lower right, one holding a torch. Setting: marshland with dead trees, mist, murky water; five heads, four legs, one tail.

LARGE (panther body about 3 m long). SOLO. A displacer beast stalks through a moonlit forest: a sleek six-legged panther-like predator with glossy blue-black fur, glowing green eyes, and two long whip-like tentacles growing from its shoulders, each ending in a pad of bony spikes. It leaps forward to the right; its image shimmers and appears doubled as a faint offset ghost-copy, showing its displacement magic. Setting: shadowy forest with ferns and moon shafts; EXACTLY six legs, two tentacles, one tail.

GARGANTUAN (about 2.5 m across, over 25 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A purple worm bursts up out of the rocky desert floor: an enormous segmented worm with glossy deep purple armored plates, a huge round maw ringed with rows of inward-pointing teeth, and a venomous stinger on its distant tail. It erupts vertically in an explosion of rock and sand, gaping maw arching high toward the right; two tiny adventurers seen from behind stand their ground at the lower right, weapons ready. Setting: cracked badlands, dust cloud, falling boulders; no eyes, no legs.

MEDIUM (low, about 3 m long including tail). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A basilisk creeps through a dim cave: an eight-legged heavy reptile with dull brown-green scales, a row of short spines along its back, a broad flat head and glowing green eyes. It raises its head and fixes its petrifying gaze toward the right, where at the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind shields their eyes with a raised arm, standing firm, sword ready. Setting: cave littered with stone statues of animals and a weathered stone statue of an explorer; EXACTLY eight legs.

LARGE (lion body about 3 m long). SOLO. A manticore swoops down from a rocky crag: the body of a tawny lion, large leathery brown dragon-like wings, a bearded humanoid face with a wild mane and fanged snarl, and a long tail ending in a cluster of iron-hard spikes. It flicks its tail and hurls a volley of spikes toward the right. Setting: windswept mountain cliffs, dust and scrub, scattered bones; four legs, two wings, one tail.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A chimera lands on a ruined hilltop: a lion body with tawny fur, large leathery red dragon wings, and EXACTLY three heads on separate necks: a roaring lion head in the center, a horned goat head on one side, and a red dragon head on the other side that breathes a cone of fire toward the right that splashes against a broken wall. Behind that wall, at the lower right edge, a single adventurer seen from behind crouches ready with a drawn sword. Setting: rocky hills, scorched grass, smoke; four legs, two wings, three heads, one tail.

MEDIUM (about the size of a pony, low to the ground). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A rust monster scuttles across a dungeon floor: an insect-like quadruped with rough rust-orange and brown armored hide, a long segmented tail ending in a bony paddle, and two long feathery antennae. Its antennae touch the steel shield of a single adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind; the shield crumbles into flakes of red rust where touched. Setting: dungeon chamber with rusted armor fragments scattered around; four legs, two antennae, one tail.

LARGE (about 3 m long, heavy as a wagon). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A bulette leaps out of the ground in an open meadow: a massive armored predator with gray-blue plated hide, a huge shark-like head with a jagged toothy mouth, a high crest dorsal fin along its back, and four short powerful legs with digging claws. It launches into a leap, dirt and turf flying, toward two small adventurers seen from behind at the lower right. Setting: grassy hills, a wooden fence and haystack for scale; four legs, one head.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An umber hulk bursts through a cavern wall: a hulking insectoid brute with glossy dark brown-black chitin, a bulky beetle-like head with large mandibles, FOUR eyes (two large compound and two small), and two powerful arms with huge digging claws. Its four eyes glow with a swirling hypnotic shimmer as it fixes on a single adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who averts their gaze, weapon ready. Setting: underground tunnel with falling rubble and dust; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, armored). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A death knight strides through a ruined chapel: an undead warrior in blackened, scorched plate armor with spiked pauldrons, a horned helm whose visor reveals a burned skull with glowing red pinpoint eyes, a tattered dark cape. In one hand it holds a long black sword wreathed in dark flame, held low; the other hand conjures a roiling orb of hellfire, raised high. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind raises a holy symbol. Setting: shattered stained-glass windows (no figures), broken pews, ember light; two arms, two legs.

HUGE (about 12 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A dracolich rears among ruins: an undead dragon whose skeleton is partly covered with dry, torn gray hide and tattered wing membranes, glowing green pinpoint eyes in its horned skull. It breathes a cone of sickly green necrotic energy high over the ruins toward the right. Two small adventurers seen from behind stand their ground on broken stone at the lower right. Setting: shattered temple ruins under a stormy sky; four legs, two wings, one head, one tail.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A mummy lord rises in its tomb chamber: a regal desiccated corpse wrapped in ancient linen bandages, wearing a gilded pharaonic headdress, golden collar and bracers, glowing blue eyes in a sunken face. It raises both arms to summon a whirlwind of swirling golden sand that spins toward the right. Setting: tomb with painted pillars (no legible writing), sarcophagus, golden treasure; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A ghost drifts through a dusty abandoned manor: the translucent pale blue-white spectral form of a woman in an old-fashioned flowing dress, her lower body fading into mist, hair floating as if underwater. She reaches out with a skeletal-looking transparent hand, her face shifting into a horrifying visage. Setting: dark manor hallway with draped furniture, a cracked mirror and moonlight; two arms, no feet visible.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A wraith glides through a ruined crypt: a hooded figure of shadow and tattered black rags, its face a void with two burning red points, its lower body trailing off into dark smoke. It reaches out with a long clawed hand of shadow, cold pale mist curling from its fingers. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind stands firm, raising a glowing holy symbol. Setting: dark crypt with cold blue light; two arms.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A banshee floats over a moorland pool at night: the translucent spirit of an elven woman with long white hair streaming upward, a gaunt pale face, a tattered flowing gown, glowing faint blue. Her mouth gapes open in a deathly wail, visible as pale concentric ripples of sound spreading toward the right. Setting: dark moor, dead reeds, crooked trees, mist; two arms, no feet.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A ghoul leaps out of an open grave: a gaunt gray-skinned humanoid with long sharp claws, a long tongue, pointed teeth, wild eyes and matted hair, dressed in rags. It pounces forward toward a single adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind who raises a mace. Setting: foggy cemetery at night; no gore; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A wight strides out of a barrow mound: an undead warrior with withered gray skin, glowing cold blue eyes and a leathery face, wearing rusted chain mail and a fur cloak. It holds a longsword in one hand, its blade frosted with necrotic energy, and lunges toward a single adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind. Setting: snowy barrow-field with standing stones at dusk; two arms, two legs.

TINY (a single human skull). SOLO. A flameskull floats in a wizard's tower library: a human skull wreathed in green-and-orange flickering flames, its eye sockets burning with fierce light. It fires a ray of fire toward the right, scorching a bookshelf. A candle and an open book on a desk nearby show its small size. Setting: tower study with scrolls and books (no legible writing); no body.

TINY (a skull). SOLO. A demilich floats above a dusty treasure hoard in a sealed tomb: a cracked ancient human skull with gemstones set in its eye sockets and teeth, surrounded by a swirling cloud of gray grave dust. It howls, sending ripples of dark energy outward toward the right. Coins, a jeweled crown and bones on the floor give scale. Setting: sealed vault, dim violet light; no body.

LARGE (a floating sphere about 2.5 m across). SOLO. A death tyrant, an undead beholder, hovers in a crumbling lair: its spherical body is a bare bleached skull-like bone shell with cracks, a single huge empty eye socket glowing with a pinpoint of cold red light, a fanged jaw, and EXACTLY ten withered eyestalks rising from the top. Several eyestalks fire thin colored rays from their tips toward the right, while its central eye projects a cone of dark negative energy. Setting: underground cavern with bones and shattered stone; it floats, no limbs.

LARGE (about 6 m long). SOLO. An aboleth rises from a dark underground lake: an ancient fish-like aberration with smooth blue-green slimy skin, a pale underbelly, THREE red eyes stacked vertically on its head, a broad tail fin and FOUR long tentacles trailing from its sides. It looms from the water, its eyes glowing as it exerts mind control; slime and mist surround it. Setting: vast Underdark cavern with ancient carved pillars half-submerged; three eyes, four tentacles, one tail.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient blue dragon rears on a desert ridge: deep sapphire blue scales, a single large horn on its snout, a frill of swept-back horns around its head, large wings spread wide, and a long tail. It breathes a crackling line of lightning from its open mouth toward the right, striking a ruined pillar on the right; two tiny adventurers seen from behind brace at the lower right, weapons ready. Setting: sand dunes, ruined desert ruins, storm clouds; four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient green dragon coils among giant trees: emerald green scales, a long crest along its spine, a frill on its jaw, broad wings half folded. It breathes a billowing cloud of toxic green poison gas that rolls between the trees toward the right; two tiny adventurers seen from behind hold their ground behind a mossy ruin wall at the lower right, weapons ready. Setting: ancient misty forest, fallen logs, mossy ruins; four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient black dragon rises from a swamp: glossy black scales, a skull-like head with deep-set eyes, two large forward-curving horns, and leathery wings. It breathes a line of sizzling acid toward the right, which hisses into the swamp water well short of two tiny adventurers seen from behind at the lower right. Setting: dark swamp with ruins and dead trees; four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 18 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient white dragon crouches on a glacier: icy white scales with pale blue tinges, a crested head with short horns, broad wings, a long tail. It breathes a cone of freezing blue-white frost toward the right, coating the glacier ice in front of two tiny adventurers seen from behind at the lower right. Setting: frozen cliffs and snowstorm; four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient gold dragon soars majestically above a mountain lake: gleaming golden scales, a long whiskered snout, a crown of horns and frills, and huge sail-like wings. It breathes a cone of brilliant golden fire toward the right to protect two tiny adventurers seen from behind on a cliff at the lower right. Setting: sunlit mountains, waterfalls, clouds; four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient silver dragon perches on a snowy mountain peak: shining silver scales, a smooth head with a frill, broad wings outspread. It breathes a cone of silvery frost toward the right, freezing a waterfall into ice, while two tiny adventurers seen from behind look up at it from the lower right. Setting: cloudy alpine summit; four legs, two wings, one head.

SMALL (about 0.9 m tall, knee-to-waist height of a human). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A kobold warrior darts out of a narrow mine tunnel: a small reptilian humanoid with rust-red scales, a dog-like snout, two small backward horns, a thin tail, and yellow slit eyes squinting against the light, wearing scraps of leather armor. It lunges with a dagger gripped in one clawed hand, while several more kobolds peek from cracks behind. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind, far taller than the kobolds, lowers a torch. Setting: mine tunnel with timber supports, an ore cart; two arms, two legs, one tail.

LARGE (about 5 m long with tail). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A wyvern swoops down from the sky: a dark brown-green dragon-like creature with leathery wings that also serve as forelimbs, two clawed hind legs, a long neck and a long tail ending in a venomous stinger. It strikes toward the right with its stinger, while a single adventurer seen from behind on a rocky outcrop at the lower right raises a spear. Setting: mountain cliffs, wind, clouds; two legs, two wings, one tail.

MEDIUM (about 2.1 m tall, long-limbed). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A bugbear warrior ambushes from the shadow of a huge oak on a forest road: a hulking, hairy goblinoid with coarse yellow-brown fur, a broad bearish face with a flat nose, small fangs and long pointed ears, wearing patched hide armor and a dark fur mantle. It lunges forward with one long arm outstretched to grab, a light hammer gripped firmly in the other hand held low. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind spins around, lantern raised and sword drawn. Setting: dusky forest road, gnarled roots, a fallen signpost; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, broad-shouldered). WITH ADVENTURERS in the distance. A hobgoblin captain leads a disciplined charge across a muddy battlefield: an orange-red skinned goblinoid with a flat dark nose, sharp yellow eyes and black braided hair, wearing well-kept lacquered splint armor and a crested iron helm. The captain strides forward, a greatsword gripped firmly in both hands held low and angled forward, mouth open in a barked command, while a disciplined line of hobgoblin soldiers with spears advances in the gloom behind. Two small adventurers seen from behind hold a barricade at the lower right. Setting: war camp palisade, plain unmarked banners, smoke; two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (about 2.2 m tall, lanky). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gnoll warrior rampages across a sun-baked savanna: a lanky hyena-headed humanoid with spotted tan-and-gray fur, a bristling dark mane down its neck, a long muzzle full of fangs and wild yellow eyes, wearing crude armor of hide straps and bones. It bounds forward on two digitigrade legs with clawed hands reaching, a bone bow slung across its back, cackling with jaws open. A pack of more gnolls lopes behind it in the dust. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind braces a spear. Setting: dry grass, acacia trees, dust haze; two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 2.8 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An ogre stomps through a forest trail: a huge, heavy humanoid with thick gray-brown skin, a big belly, a dull brutish face with tusks, wearing ragged hides. It swings a giant wooden club held low in one hand. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right holds a spear. Setting: forest, broken cart; two arms, two legs.

HUGE (about 5 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A hill giant stomps across rolling hills: a massive crude humanoid with ruddy skin, a heavy brow, unkempt hair and a large belly, wearing hides and furs. It carries a whole uprooted tree as a club held low in one hand and roars. Two adventurers seen from behind stand at the lower right. Setting: grassy hills, sheep, farmhouse; two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 3 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A frost giant strides through a snowstorm: pale blue-white skin, long icy white hair and beard braided with iron rings, wearing furs and chain mail. It holds a large greataxe with frost on its blade in one hand at its side and roars a war cry. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right. Setting: icy mountain pass; two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 3.5 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

HUGE (about 5.5 m tall, broad as a fortress gate). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A fire giant stands in its volcanic forge-hall: coal-black skin, a blazing beard and hair of living orange-red flame, a stern heavy-browed face, wearing massive blackened plate armor with riveted pauldrons. It stalks forward with a huge greatsword whose blade burns with fire, gripped firmly in one hand and swept low toward the right, sparks trailing behind the blade. Two adventurers seen from behind stand on a stone walkway at the lower right. Setting: lava channels, giant anvils, chains and glowing furnaces; two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 3.2 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

HUGE (about 8 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A storm giant stands on a sea cliff in a raging storm: pale lavender-blue skin, long silvery hair, wearing flowing robes and armor. It raises one hand calling down a bolt of lightning that strikes the sea toward the right. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right. Setting: stormy coast with crashing waves; two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 4.5 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

HUGE (about 7 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A cloud giant stands on the marble terrace of a castle floating among clouds: pale gray-blue skin, long silver-white hair bound with jewelled clasps, a noble bearded face, wearing fine pale blue robes over a silver breastplate and rich jewelry. It holds a great flanged mace firmly in one hand at its side while its other hand is raised, gathering a dark swirling thundercloud crackling with lightning that rolls toward the right. Two adventurers seen from behind stand at the lower right on the terrace. Setting: white towers, drifting clouds, bright sky; two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 4 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A carrion crawler on a dungeon wall: a huge segmented, worm-like creature with greenish-gray body plates, many pairs of short legs, a head with a beak-like mouth and a cluster of eight long writhing tentacles around its mouth. It crawls down the wall and lashes its tentacles toward the right at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge. Setting: damp sewer-like tunnels, moss, faint torchlight.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A hook horror in a dark Underdark cavern: a hulking bipedal monster with a vulture-like beaked head, a hard gray chitinous exoskeleton and long arms ending in huge curved hooks instead of hands. It swings one hook toward the right at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge. Setting: stalactites, glowing fungi and dark pools. Two arms with hooks, two legs, one head.

HUGE (about 12 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A remorhaz bursts from a frozen tundra: a huge centipede-like creature with many legs, a segmented blue-white armored body, a head with large mandibles, and a ridge of back plates glowing red-hot with heat that melts the surrounding snow into steam. It rears up and lunges toward the right at two small adventurers in the lower right foreground, seen from behind. Setting: icy plain, blowing snow, steam clouds.

HUGE (about 12 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A behir coils in a mountain cave: a huge serpentine reptile with a long blue-scaled body, twelve legs, a horned crocodile-like head and glowing eyes. It breathes a crackling bolt of lightning from its open jaws toward the right, striking a rock pillar beside two small adventurers seen from behind in the lower right foreground, who brace with weapons ready. Setting: rocky cave walls, rubble and a stormy sky visible through the cave mouth. Twelve legs, one head.

LARGE (horse-sized wolf). WITH ADVENTURERS. A winter wolf on a snowy tundra: a huge white-furred wolf with frost crystals in its fur, pale blue glowing eyes and long fangs. It breathes a cone of freezing blue frost toward the right, frosting the ground in front of two small adventurers seen from behind in the lower right foreground, who brace behind shields. Setting: snowy pines, blowing snow, gray sky. Four legs, one head. Its fur bristles with icicles along the spine, and the frost coats the ground in a fan of glittering ice where the breath strikes. Snow sprays up from its paws as it plants its forelegs.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A yeti in a frozen mountain pass: a hulking white-furred ape-like creature with a wide face, fierce blue eyes and long clawed hands. It raises a chunk of ice, about to hurl it toward the right at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge. Setting: snowy cliffs, blowing snow, ice crystals. Two arms, two legs, one head. Its breath steams in the cold, its fur is matted with snow, and its pale eyes glint with a freezing gaze. It stands on a snowy ledge slightly above the adventurer, who raises a torch that makes it flinch. SCALE CHECK: the yeti is only about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer; do not exaggerate.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. In a dim inn's back room a doppelganger is caught mid-transformation: its true form is a lean, hairless humanoid with smooth pale-gray skin, a nearly featureless face with large blank silvery eyes without pupils, a small slit mouth and long thin fingers; the right half of its body is still shifting into the likeness of a cloaked human traveler, the change rippling across it like wax. It turns toward the right, one long hand reaching out, its unsettling face revealed in candlelight. Setting: wooden beams, a cracked mirror, a single candle and drifting shadows. Two arms, two legs, one head; eerie, not gory.

LARGE (wingspan about 3 m). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A cloaker detaches from the ceiling of an Underdark cavern: a manta-ray-like creature whose upper side looks like a dark leathery black cloak with bone-like claws along its edges, its pale underside revealing two glowing red eyes, rows of sharp fangs and a long whiplike tail. It swoops down and spreads wide as it swoops toward an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, who raises a torch. Ghostly shadow-phantoms of the cloaker flicker around it. Setting: dripping stalactites, glowing blue fungi, deep darkness. No arms, no legs, one tail.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A roper waits disguised among stalagmites in a dark cavern: a thick, cone-shaped creature of rough gray-brown stony hide indistinguishable from the surrounding rock, with a single large glowing yellow eye and below it a wide mouth ringed with jagged teeth. Six long, sticky, rope-like tentacles shoot out from its sides toward the right, one whipping past an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, who raises a sword. Setting: dripping stalactites, dark pools and pale glowing fungi; other stalagmites of similar shape for camouflage. One eye, one mouth, six tentacles.

LARGE (about 2.5 m across). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An otyugh rises out of a heap of refuse in a vaulted sewer: a bloated, round body of mottled brown-gray rocky hide on three thick, stumpy legs, a huge gaping mouth full of jagged teeth in the middle of its body, a stalk on top with three eyes, and two long, thick tentacles ending in spiked leafy pads. It lashes one tentacle toward the right at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, who is wading through the shallow water. Setting: brick arches, murky water, faint green light from a grate. Three legs, two tentacles, one eyestalk with three eyes.

LARGE (about 2.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A chuul surges out of a dark underground lake: a lobster-like aberration with a thick dark green-brown carapace with yellowish undertones, two enormous pincers, four jointed legs, a segmented tail, and beneath its head a cluster of short writhing paralyzing tentacles around its mouth. It rears from the water and snaps one great pincer toward the right at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, holding a lantern. Setting: stalactites, glowing fungi on the shore, ripples and spray. Two pincers, four legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A kuo-toa guards an underground lake shrine: a fish-like humanoid with slick silvery-gray scales, a large fish head with bulging round eyes, gill slits and a wide mouth, two webbed hands and two webbed feet, wearing a crude harness of shells. It hurls a sticky net toward the right at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge while gripping a barbed spear in its other hand; a crude shield on its back is covered in sticky slime. Setting: glowing fungi, black water, a lopsided idol of a fish-headed goddess built from scraps. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A githyanki knight leaps through a shimmering silver rift in the Astral Sea: a gaunt humanoid with leathery yellow skin, a narrow face, sunken dark eyes, long pointed ears and a topknot of black hair, wearing ornate ridged and spiked half-plate in black and dark red. It lunges toward the right with a gleaming silver greatsword held low in ONE hand, the blade a single straight piece, while a silvery misty step trail follows behind. Setting: silvery-violet astral mist, distant floating rocks and the skeletal remains of a dead god. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A githzerai monk in a monastery on a floating island in Limbo: a lean, ascetic humanoid with yellowish skin, a gaunt face with sunken eyes, long pointed ears, a shaved head with a short braid, wearing simple dark orange robes and wrapped forearms. It strikes forward with an open palm toward the right, a shimmering ripple of violet psionic force bursting from its hand, while a faint protective psionic aura surrounds it. Setting: floating stone fragments and swirling chaotic colors in the background. Two arms, two legs, one head; calm and focused.

TINY (about 30 cm long, the size of a cat). SOLO. An intellect devourer creeps across a dark Underdark cave floor: a creature that looks like a living brain with a pinkish-gray wrinkled surface, walking on four bestial clawed legs, no head or eyes. It scuttles toward the right over damp stone, a faint violet psychic aura pulsing around it. Clear scale cues: a dropped human helmet larger than the creature, scattered pebbles and a human boot at the right edge. Four legs, no head.

MEDIUM (human-sized, hunched). SOLO. A nothic lurks in a ruined underground library: a hunched, gangly humanoid with gray-green skin, long sharp claws and a single enormous glowing eye taking up most of its face, a wide mouth full of crooked teeth beneath. It turns its glowing eye toward the right, casting a sickly green beam of rotting gaze across fallen bookshelves. Setting: toppled shelves, scattered blank pages, a guttering candle and cobwebs. Two arms, two legs, one eye; no readable text.

MEDIUM (about 1.2 m across). SOLO. A spectator guards a treasure vault: a floating spherical creature with mottled brown-gray hide, a single large central eye, a wide mouth of sharp teeth and EXACTLY four eyestalks rising from its top, each ending in a small eye. It fires a thin pale-yellow ray from one eyestalk tip toward the right, the central eye glaring watchfully. Setting: a stone vault with piles of gold coins, an iron-bound chest and a torch on the wall for scale. No limbs, it floats.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m across). SOLO. A gibbering mouther oozes across a flooded cave floor: an amorphous, shapeless blob of glistening pale-pinkish flesh covered in many eyes of different sizes and many small mouths with teeth, constantly shifting. It surges toward the right, spitting a glob of sparkling blinding saliva, the ground beneath it rippling like soft mud. Setting: dark cave walls, puddles and faint greenish light. Unsettling, not gory.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A grell hovers silently above a dark cave passage: a floating creature resembling a huge brain with a sharp, curved beak at its front and EXACTLY ten long barbed tentacles dangling beneath it. It swoops down toward the right, tentacles reaching for an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge. Setting: dark stone corridor with stalactites, a faint lantern glow. No eyes, beak, ten tentacles.

MEDIUM (about 2.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A grick strikes from a rocky cave ledge: a worm-like creature with a rubbery gray-green body that blends in with stone, its head a sharp beak surrounded by four segmented tentacles. It lunges toward the right, tentacles spread wide, at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge. Setting: dark cave walls, scattered stones and dim torchlight. No legs, four tentacles, one beak.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). SOLO. A red slaad in the chaotic plane of Limbo: a hulking, upright toad-like humanoid with mottled red-orange skin, a wide froggy mouth full of teeth, bulging eyes, two thick arms with long sharp claws and two powerful legs. It leaps toward the right, claws extended, its wounds visibly regenerating. Setting: swirling chaotic colors and floating chunks of earth, water and fire. Two arms, two legs, one head.

HUGE (about 15 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A shadow dragon emerges from darkness in a ruined underground city: a dragon whose scales are smoky black and translucent at the edges, with glowing pale eyes, curved horns, two tattered wings and a long tail, its outline blending into the shadows. It breathes a cone of swirling black shadow toward the right over the crumbling columns, while two small adventurers seen from behind in the lower right foreground stand their ground. Setting: crumbling columns and pale light. Four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A dragon turtle rises from a stormy sea: a colossal turtle with a deep green and gold spiked shell, a scaly dragon-like head with horns and fins, and four flippers. It breathes a scalding cloud of steam into the storm sky toward the right, ahead of a small sailing ship whose few tiny sailors stand at the rail. Setting: dark stormy sea, lightning, huge waves. Four flippers, one head.

TINY (about 30 cm long, cat-sized). SOLO. A pseudodragon perches on an open book on a wizard's desk: a tiny dragon with red-brown scales, two small bat-like wings, two small horns, a slender barbed tail and bright intelligent eyes. It spreads its wings and hisses toward the right, tail raised to sting. Clear scale cues: an inkpot, a quill, a burning candle and a human hand at the right edge. Four legs, two wings; no readable text.

TINY (about 30 cm long). SOLO. A faerie dragon flits through a magical twilight forest: a tiny dragon with iridescent violet-blue scales and two delicate butterfly wings shimmering in rainbow colors. It breathes a puff of sparkling euphoria gas toward the right, partially invisible at the tail. Clear scale cues: wildflowers taller than it, a mushroom and dewdrops. Four legs, two wings. Fireflies drift around it, the gas glitters with tiny stars, and a curious fox in the grass below is caught laughing in the shimmering cloud. Soft violet and golden twilight light.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long, a young dragon). WITH ONE ADVENTURER for scale. A red dragon wyrmling in a volcanic cave: a young dragon with glossy crimson scales, small swept-back horns, a jaw frill, two wings and a long tail. It breathes a jet of fire toward the right, splashing against the volcanic rock beside an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, who stands ready behind a raised shield. Setting: volcanic rock and glowing lava. Four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient bronze dragon rises from a stormy coastline: a colossal dragon with gleaming bronze scales, a ridged frill, swept-back horns, two great wings and a long tail. It breathes a crackling bolt of lightning toward the right, striking the waves beyond two small adventurers seen from behind on a rocky outcrop in the lower right foreground, who stand their ground. Setting: crashing waves, dark sky. Four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient copper dragon perches on a red-rock canyon cliff: a colossal dragon with burnished copper scales turning blue-green at the edges, curved horns, a wide frill, two great wings and a long tail. It breathes a stream of acid toward the right that hisses against the canyon rock, while two small adventurers seen from behind in the lower right foreground stand ready behind a boulder. Setting: desert canyons. Four legs, two wings, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 20 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An ancient brass dragon basks on a sun-baked desert dune: a colossal dragon with gleaming brass-gold scales, a large ornate crest-like head plate, two great wings and a long tail. It breathes a cone of fire high over the dunes toward the right, while two small adventurers seen from behind in the lower right foreground stand their ground. Setting: desert dunes, a ruined pyramid in the distance. Four legs, two wings, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gaunt vampire spawn with ashen gray-white skin, sunken red-glowing eyes, long elongated fangs and sharp black-nailed claws, dressed in torn dark finery, scuttles headfirst DOWN a crumbling crypt wall like a spider, mouth open in a hungry hiss, one clawed hand reaching toward the right. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind raises a lantern, its light catching the creature's pale face. Setting: a moonlit, cobwebbed family mausoleum with stone coffins; two arms, two legs, no wings.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A specter, a translucent pale-blue spectral humanoid figure whose body dissolves below the waist into trailing wisps of mist, with hollow dark eye sockets glowing faintly and a gaping silent mouth, glides THROUGH a solid stone wall of a ruined chapel, half of its body still emerging from the masonry. One long ghostly hand stretches forward, frost and a chill pale glow spreading from its fingers as it drains life. Setting: a dim, abandoned chapel with toppled pews and a single guttering candle on the floor for scale.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A shadow undead: a flat, inky-black humanoid silhouette with faintly glowing pale eyes and elongated clawed fingers, detaches itself from a torch-lit dungeon wall and slides across the flagstones toward a lone adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, whose own cast shadow it is about to swipe at with a long dark hand. Its edges smear like smoke. Setting: a narrow dungeon corridor with a single wall torch casting hard light; the shadow is darker than any natural shadow around it.

TINY (a floating light the size of a fist). SOLO. A will-o'-wisp, a ghostly orb of pale blue-white light with a faint, barely suggested skull-like face in its core, hovers over a misty night marsh, crackling with small arcs of electricity. Several dimmer echo lights drift deeper in the fog as false lures. Below it, a narrow rotten boardwalk leads off into black water, with reeds, a dead tree and a lost lantern on the planks for scale. The orb's cold glow lights the mist from inside. No body, no limbs, only light.

TINY (a single severed human hand). SOLO. A crawling claw, a withered gray-brown undead hand severed at the wrist, scuttles across a wizard's cluttered desk on its fingertips like a spider, knocking over an inkwell, toward a lit candle and an open book with blank pages. Five fingers, one thumb, cracked yellow nails, no blood. The candle, quills and books give clear scale cues. Setting: a dim necromancer's study with skulls and jars on shelves fading into warm parchment edges.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A mummy wrapped in dusty, yellowed linen bandages with dry, dark leathery skin showing between the gaps, two glowing eyes burning in a withered face beneath a faded funerary headdress, steps out of an opened painted sarcophagus in a tomb chamber, one bandaged arm reaching forward. Its dreadful glare fixes on a lone adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who stands firm, raising a torch. Setting: a desert tomb with stone columns, painted walls without any writing, drifting dust in torchlight.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A ghast, a lean, hunched undead humanoid with taut gray-green skin over sharp bones, a long tongue, pointed teeth, burning eyes and long claws, crouches on top of an opened grave mound and springs forward through a faint greenish stench-haze. Setting: a fog-bound graveyard at night with leaning headstones (no inscriptions), a broken iron fence and a dead tree; a fallen shovel in the dirt for scale. Two arms, two legs, ragged scraps of burial clothing, no gore.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A revenant, a gaunt undead warrior with dried, gray-brown leathery skin stretched over its skull, wearing battered armor and a tattered cloak, strides relentlessly through rain and wind, its eyes blazing with a fierce vengeful glow as it fixes a fleeing figure — a lone adventurer seen from behind at the right edge, looking back over their shoulder. The revenant's fists are clenched, no weapon. Setting: a storm-lashed moor road at dusk with a broken milestone and gallows tree.

LARGE (serpentine skeleton about 4 m long). SOLO. A bone naga, the animated skeleton of a giant serpent — a long spine of pale yellowed vertebrae and ribs — rising in coils with a humanlike skull at its head, faint violet light burning in the eye sockets. It rears up over a ruined altar, jaws open, casting a spell: a ribbon of dark violet necrotic energy coils from its mouth toward the right. No arms, no legs, no flesh. Setting: a sunken temple vault with cracked serpent statues and broken stairs for scale.

LARGE (floating sphere about 2.5 m across). SOLO. A beholder zombie: a decaying, gray-green spherical body with sagging, cracked hide, ONE clouded milky central eye, a slack fanged jaw hanging open, and EXACTLY ten eyestalks on top, several of them broken, withered stumps; the remaining ones twitch. It drifts sluggishly through a collapsed underground tunnel and fires a single sickly ray from the tip of one eyestalk at a cracking stone wall on the right. No limbs. Setting: a fungus-lit cavern with toppled mining carts for scale.

LARGE (about 2.8 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. The animated skeleton of a minotaur: a massive humanoid skeleton with a horned bull skull, two great curved horns, cold lights in the eye sockets, exactly two arms and two legs, charges head-down through a labyrinth corridor, horns lowered. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, braces against a wall to dodge; they reach only to the skeleton's chest. Setting: a crumbling stone maze with dust kicked up by the charge.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An oni, a towering ogre-like fiend with deep blue skin, a shock of wild white hair, two short ivory horns, tusked fangs and burning eyes, wearing ornate lacquered armor plates and a sash, stands in a moonlit mountain shrine and unleashes a sickly purple nightmare ray from its outstretched open palm toward the right, splashing against a stone lantern beside a lone adventurer at the right edge, seen from behind, who stands ready with a sword drawn. Its other hand rests on a huge glaive grounded upright. Setting: a misty pine-forest shrine with stone lanterns for scale.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A sahuagin warrior, a fish-like humanoid with dark green scales, a paler belly, a fanned dorsal spine fin running down its back, black eyes, a shark-toothed mouth and webbed clawed hands and feet, surges out of breaking surf onto wet rocks in an aquatic charge, claws spread. A lone sailor-adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind on the slick rocks, raises a cutlass. Setting: a stormy rocky coastline at dusk with a moored rowboat for scale; two arms, two legs, one tail fin.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS. A merrow, a hulking aquatic ogre with mottled blue-green scaly skin, a heavy brutish head with jagged teeth, long clawed arms, a thick fish-like lower body with a tail instead of legs, clad in seaweed and shells, rears out of the water beside a small boat and hurls a barbed harpoon trailing a rope toward the right. Two adventurers in the boat at the lower right, seen from behind, brace with oars and a shield. Setting: a dark coastal lagoon under a stormy sky.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS. A cyclops sentry, a huge giant with weathered tan skin, a single large eye in the middle of its forehead, a heavy brow, wild dark hair and a rough hide tunic, stands at a rocky mountain pass and hurls a boulder down the slope toward the right. A massive stone club hangs from its other hand. Two adventurers at the lower right, seen from behind, take cover behind rocks, weapons ready. Setting: a wind-swept island cliff with goats scattering. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 3.5 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

HUGE (about 5 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS. A fomorian, a misshapen huge giant with lumpy, warty gray skin, one eye enormous and the other tiny, a lopsided jaw and a hunched, mismatched body, crouches in an underground cavern and casts its warping hex: a sickly green curse light streams from its large eye toward the right, washing over the cavern rock, while two adventurers at the lower right, seen from behind, stand their ground, weapons raised. A crude stone club rests in its fist. Setting: a gloomy Underdark cavern with crude stone dwellings; two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 3 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

LARGE (body as big as a horse). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A phase spider, a giant spider with dark violet-black carapace, eight long jointed legs, a cluster of glittering eyes and venomous fangs, is half-materializing out of shimmering ethereal mist — its rear half translucent, its front half solid — as it lunges with fangs bared at a lone adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge. Setting: a ruined, web-draped forest temple at twilight. Exactly eight legs.

TINY (the size of a crow). SOLO. A swarm-lit close-up of a stirge, a hideous bat-winged creature with a rust-red mosquito-like body, four small clawed legs, leathery membranous wings and a long needle-like proboscis, darting down out of the dark of a cave mouth toward the right with proboscis thrust forward. Several more stirges flutter in the gloom behind it. Setting: a damp cave entrance with a dropped lantern and a backpack on the rocks for scale.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An ankheg, a huge insectoid burrower with a glossy brown-amber chitin carapace, six segmented legs, long antennae and powerful mandibles, bursts out of a farm field's soil in a spray of earth and wheat stalks and sprays a stream of greenish acid from its mandibles toward the right, spattering the wheat. A lone farmhand-adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, stands ready with a pitchfork. Setting: golden wheat fields at sunset with a wooden fence for scale. Exactly six legs.

SMALL (about knee height to a human). SOLO. A cockatrice, a scrawny creature with the head and legs of a rooster, a red wattle and comb, leathery batlike wings and a long scaly serpent tail, flaps up on a broken stone wall with its beak open in a screech. In front of it on the right stands a half-petrified stone fox, mid-leap, turning to gray stone from its tail up. Setting: an overgrown ruined farmyard with scattered stone hens for scale; two wings, two legs.

LARGE (serpentine body about 4 m long). SOLO. A salamander, a fiery elemental with the torso, head and arms of a scaled humanoid and the long coiled lower body of a serpent, its orange-red scales glowing with heat, a crest of flickering flames along its head and spine, thrusts a white-hot iron spear forward toward the right. The air shimmers around it. Two arms, no legs. Setting: a basalt forge-hall in the Plane of Fire with rivers of molten metal.

MEDIUM (about as tall as a human). SOLO. A xorn, a squat barrel-shaped creature of speckled stone with three thick clawed arms and three stubby legs arranged radially around its body, three large stone-lidded eyes spaced around its upper body, and a wide fang-lined mouth on top of its head, emerges halfway out of a solid rock wall of a gem mine and reaches toward glittering gems in an open chest. Setting: a mine tunnel with timber supports and a pickaxe for scale. Exactly three arms, three legs, three eyes.

MEDIUM (dwarf-sized, about 1.4 m tall). SOLO. An azer sentinel, a stocky dwarflike being with bronze-colored metallic skin, a beard and hair made of living flames, wearing a heavy brass kilt and bracers, brings a glowing burning warhammer down onto an anvil with one hand, sparks and flames bursting outward toward the right. Setting: a brass fortress forge in the Plane of Fire with molten channels; tongs and ingots for scale. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A sea hag, a hideous fey crone with slimy, scaly green-gray skin, long tangled seaweed-like hair, filmy eyes, webbed clawed fingers and tattered fishing-net clothing, rises from a tide pool in a sea cave and fixes a terrible death glare on a lone sailor-adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, who stands firm, cutlass raised, eyes averted. Setting: a dripping sea cave with barnacled rocks and shipwreck debris for scale. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A dryad, a graceful fey woman whose skin has the texture and color of pale birch bark, with hair of leaves and blossoms and a face of serene, wild beauty, steps half out of the trunk of a great oak as she lashes thorny vines from her outstretched hand toward the right, the vines whipping across a forest glade. Setting: a sunlit ancient forest with mossy roots and wildflowers. Two arms, two legs.

TINY (about 30 cm tall, the size of a hand). SOLO. A pixie, a tiny fey with delicate translucent butterfly wings, pointed ears, a mischievous grin and clothes of flower petals, hovers over a mushroom ring and scatters a sparkling stream of golden faerie dust from her open palm toward the right. Setting: a twilight forest floor with toadstools, ferns and a dewdrop-covered leaf giving the scale; fireflies drift. Two arms, two legs, four wings.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A satyr, a fey with the upper body of a lithe, bearded man, two curling ram horns, pointed ears and the shaggy goat legs and cloven hooves of a goat, dances on a mossy stone in a moonlit grove while playing a set of reed panpipes, his laughing gaze directed to the right at an unseen audience. Wild magic ripples from the music as glowing notes of light without symbols. Setting: a forest glade with wine cups and garlands. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (wolf-sized). SOLO. A blink dog, a lean, intelligent dog with sandy-yellow fur and alert ears, teleports mid-leap: a faint ghostly afterimage of it remains on the left where it vanished, while the solid dog reappears in a flash of shimmering light center-right, snapping its jaws. Setting: a sunny fey woodland meadow with tall grass and a fallen log for scale. Four legs, one tail.

LARGE (as big as a horse). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A worg, a monstrous evil wolf with matted dark gray-black fur, a heavy head, burning yellow eyes and bared fangs, leaps from a rocky outcrop through snow, jaws open, toward a lone adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, raising a spear. Setting: a cold mountain forest at dusk with snow-laden pines. Four legs, one tail.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). SOLO. A centaur trooper, a creature with the upper body of a muscular human and the lower body of a chestnut horse, wearing a leather jerkin and a quiver, gallops across an open grassland at full speed, drawing a longbow to the cheek with an arrow aimed to the right. Setting: wide plains under a big sky with wind-swept grass. Two arms, four horse legs, one tail.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A bullywug warrior, a frog-like humanoid with mottled green-brown skin, bulging eyes, a wide mouth, webbed hands and powerful frog legs, wearing a rough reed-woven tunic and a beetle-shell helmet, leaps high from a lily pad across a swamp, thrusting a thin insectile rapier made from a giant insect's stinger toward the right. Setting: a steamy bog with cattails and a half-sunken boat for scale. Two arms, two legs.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A goblin boss, a small humanoid with yellow-green skin, a flat face, a wide mouth full of small sharp teeth, large pointed ears and red eyes, wearing a dented chain shirt and a trophy-decorated cap, stands on a crate in a cave hideout and snarls orders, pointing a curved scimitar to the right. Two goblin warriors crouch around it. At the lower right edge an adventurer seen from behind towers over them, showing the scale. Setting: torch-lit cave lair with loot sacks.

LARGE (serpent body about 6 m long). SOLO. A guardian naga, a majestic serpent with shimmering emerald-green and gold scales, a crest of golden frills and a wise humanlike face, coils protectively around a sealed temple doorway and rears up, spitting a spray of glittering venom toward the right while a soft golden radiance shines around her. No arms, no legs. Setting: a jungle temple sanctuary with stone pillars and incense braziers for scale.

LARGE (wingspan about 6 m). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant eagle with golden-brown plumage, a white head, a hooked yellow beak and enormous talons soars over a mountain chasm with wings fully spread, carrying a lone adventurer on its back, who is seen from behind and leans forward. The eagle banks toward the right, gaze fixed ahead. Setting: snowy peaks and clouds under evening light. Two wings, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An animated suit of full plate armor, completely empty inside — a dark void visible through the visor and joints — steps down from its display pedestal in a castle hall and swings a gauntleted fist toward a lone adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind. Its armor is dented, with faded heraldic colors and no symbols. Setting: a dusty castle gallery with tapestries and suits of armor on stands. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A helmed horror, an empty suit of ornate plate armor with a horned great helm, a pale blue arcane light glowing through the visor slits, floats slightly above the floor of a wizard's vault, guarding it, and thrusts a glowing spectral arcane longsword forward toward the right. Its tattered cape billows. Setting: a sealed arcane treasury with crystal pillars and chests for scale. Two arms, two legs, one sword.

TINY (about 45 cm tall). SOLO. A homunculus, a tiny, leathery green-gray construct with a humanoid body, small batlike wings, a pointed face with a needle-sharp mouth, perches on the edge of an alchemist's bench among glass flasks and bubbling retorts, hissing toward the right with its claws on a scroll without writing. Setting: a candle-lit alchemy lab with books and jars for scale. Two arms, two legs, two wings.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A shield guardian, a towering construct of wood, bronze and iron bands, with a featureless helm-like head and a small glowing amulet set in its chest, stands protectively in front of its master — a robed wizard at the lower right edge seen from behind — and swings a heavy iron fist toward an unseen attacker on the right. Setting: a ruined arcane tower at dusk. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (about 1.2 m tall). SOLO. A modron monodrone, a spherical metallic construct with a single large eye in the middle of its face, two small feathered wings, two thin mechanical arms and two jointed legs, marches in perfect formation with other identical monodrones across a vast clockwork landscape of turning gears. It flings a spinning brass gear from one hand toward the right. Setting: the plane of absolute order with geometric towers and giant cogs.

LARGE (bull-sized, about 2.5 m tall at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gorgon, a massive bull made of interlocking iron-gray metal plates, with heavy horns and glowing eyes, snorts a cone of green petrifying gas from its nostrils that rolls across the rocks toward the right; a lone adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, stands ready behind a boulder at the edge of the cloud. Several weathered stone statues stand nearby. Setting: a rocky plateau ruin under a stormy sky. Four legs.

GARGANTUAN (about 40 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS. A colossus, an immense animated statue of weathered white stone and gold, a crowned armored figure with blank glowing eyes, strides through a crumbling ancient city and fires a beam of radiant light from its eyes toward the right. At the lower right, three tiny adventurers seen from behind on a ruined rooftop look up at it; they are smaller than its foot. Setting: a vast ruined city under dramatic clouds. Two arms, two legs.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A twig blight, a small walking bundle of dry, gnarled brown twigs and brambles in a rough humanoid shape, with spindly clawed twig-fingers and no face, creeps out of a thorny thicket with several others behind it, reaching its claws toward the right. Setting: a dark, dead-wood forest edge with a lost traveler's hat and lantern on the ground for scale. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). SOLO. A myconid sovereign, a large mushroom-person with a broad spotted cap, a pale stalk-like body, thick arms and fungal frills, stands in a glowing Underdark grotto releasing a cloud of luminescent spores from its gills that drift toward the right, where smaller myconids gather. Setting: a cavern of giant bioluminescent mushrooms with soft blue and violet light. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (about human height). SOLO. A violet fungus, a tall purplish mushroom-like growth with a cluster of four long, flailing, tendril-like stalks, lashes out at a passing giant beetle on the right in a damp cave. Its surface is mottled violet and pale. Setting: a dark cavern floor with stalagmites, puddles and other fungi; a dropped torch for scale.

HUGE (about 12 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A tyrannosaurus rex with mottled olive-brown scales, a massive head and tiny forearms, bursts through a primeval forest, jaws gaping with a roar toward a lone adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, running; the adventurer reaches barely to its knee. Setting: a jungle valley with giant ferns and a smoking volcano. Two legs, two small arms, one tail.

LARGE (about 9 m long). SOLO. An allosaurus, a lean predatory dinosaur with a narrow head, short horns above its eyes, reddish-brown hide with darker stripes and strong clawed forelimbs, sprints across a dry riverbed mid-stride, jaws open, chasing toward the right. Setting: an arid prehistoric plain with scrub and boulders for scale. Two legs, two arms, one tail.

HUGE (about 9 m long). SOLO. A triceratops with a large bony neck frill, two long brow horns and a shorter nose horn, a heavy gray-green body, charges head-down through tall grasses toward the right, scattering a flock of birds. Setting: a lush prehistoric floodplain with distant volcano. Four legs, one tail.

HUGE (about 4 m at the shoulder). WITH ADVENTURERS. A woolly mammoth with shaggy reddish-brown fur, a high domed head, a long trunk and enormous curved tusks, charges through snow toward the right, kicking up a cloud of powder. Two small furs-clad adventurers at the lower right edge, seen from behind, leap aside. Setting: a frozen tundra under a pale sky. Four legs, one trunk, two tusks.

LARGE (lion-sized but heavier). SOLO. A saber-toothed tiger with tawny fur, faint stripes, a muscular build and two very long curved upper fangs, leaps from a snowy rock ledge with forelegs extended and claws out, roaring toward the right. Setting: an icy mountain valley with pines. Four legs, one short tail.

LARGE (pony-sized). SOLO. A dire wolf with thick gray fur, a heavy muzzle and a bristling mane, howls on a rocky outcrop under a full moon while its pack lopes through the snowy forest below, then turns its gaze to the right. Setting: a moonlit winter forest. Four legs, one tail.

LARGE (about 3 m tall standing). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A huge brown bear rears up on its hind legs with a roar, claws raised, toward a lone ranger at the lower right edge seen from behind, who stands firm with a spear lowered. Setting: a rushing mountain stream with salmon and pine forest. Four legs, one head.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS. A giant ape with shaggy dark fur, a massive chest and a heavy brow lifts a huge boulder above its head with both arms, about to hurl it toward the right, roaring. Two adventurers at the lower right, seen from behind, scatter among jungle ruins. Setting: an overgrown jungle temple. Two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the adventurers stand at the same distance from the viewer as the creature's feet, and the creature is only about 3.5 times as tall as they are (an adventurer's head reaches roughly its knee or lower thigh) — huge, but not a mountain; do not exaggerate.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant scorpion with glossy black-amber chitin, two large pincers and a segmented tail arched high with a venomous stinger poised to strike, scuttles across desert sand toward a lone adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind. Setting: a moonlit desert with dunes and ancient ruins. Exactly eight legs, two pincers, one tail.

HUGE (about 9 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS. A giant crocodile with dark scaly olive hide lunges out of a murky river, jaws open wide, toward a small raft with two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right. Water splashes around its massive body. Setting: a jungle river with mangrove roots. Four legs, one tail.

HUGE (about 9 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS. A giant shark with a gray-blue back and pale belly bursts up out of the waves beside a small sailboat, jaws open with rows of triangular teeth. Two sailors seen from behind on the deck at the lower right hold harpoons. Setting: a stormy open sea under dark clouds. Two pectoral fins, one dorsal fin, one tail.

HUGE (about 9 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant constrictor snake with green-and-brown patterned scales coils around the trunk of a jungle tree and strikes down with its head and open jaws toward a lone adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, slashing with a machete. Setting: a dense tropical rainforest with hanging vines. No legs, one head.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering a large area). SOLO. A swarm of dozens of gray and brown rats with red eyes pours out of a broken sewer grate and floods across wet cobblestones toward the right, climbing over each other in a living wave. Setting: a dark city sewer tunnel with a dropped lantern and a boot for scale.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. An archmage, a powerful human spellcaster in ornate deep-blue and silver robes with a tall staff topped by a glowing crystal, stands on a high tower balcony and unleashes a massive spiral of arcane energy from his outstretched hand toward the right, while a shimmering protective ward glows around him. His face shows calm focus. Setting: a lightning-filled night sky over a mountain citadel. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. An assassin, a lean figure in dark charcoal leathers with a hood and face mask, steps silently from deep shadow on a moonlit rooftop and levels a light crossbow toward an unseen target on the right; a slim shortsword hangs ready at the hip. Only cold eyes are visible. Setting: a sleeping city of steep rooftops and chimneys at night. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A bandit captain, a confident rogue in a battered long coat, tricorn hat and leather vest, stands on a fallen tree across a forest road and levels a flintlock pistol toward the right, a curved scimitar drawn in the other hand. Behind him, a few bandits emerge from the trees. Setting: a misty forest road with an overturned merchant cart. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A berserker, a wild-eyed warrior with braided hair, tattoos and furs, charges through a snowy battlefield with a greataxe held low in one hand, roaring, toward the right. Snow and dust whirl around him. Setting: a frozen fjord with burning longships in the background. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A cultist fanatic in dark crimson robes with a hood and a ritual dagger raised, stands before a ritual circle of candles in an underground shrine; a spectral glowing weapon hovers in the air beside her, attacking toward the right. Setting: a candle-lit crypt shrine with smoke and crude idols (no symbols). Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (about 2 m tall). SOLO. A thri-kreen marauder, an insectoid humanoid with sandy-yellow chitin, a mantis-like head with large compound eyes and antennae, four arms and two legs, leaps across desert dunes, hurling a curved crystalline throwing blade (chatkcha) with one of its upper hands toward the right, while holding a polearm in its lower hands. Setting: a scorching desert at sunset with half-buried ruins. Exactly four arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, larger in hybrid form). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A werebear in hybrid form, a massive bear-like humanoid with brown fur, a bear's head and powerful clawed arms, stands protectively over a forest campsite, roaring toward a pack of wolves approaching from the right. A lone traveler seen from behind at the lower right edge shelters behind it. Setting: a dark pine forest at night. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A yuan-ti malison type 1, a humanoid with a human body covered in green scales and a serpent's head, with forked tongue and slit pupils, stands in a jungle temple and casts a poisonous ray from its hand toward the right. Setting: an overgrown stone temple with snake statues. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, hunched). SOLO, but in a horde. A lemure, the lowliest devil of the Nine Hells: a slouching, sluggish humanoid shape of dull reddish-brown waxy skin that seems to sag and droop like softened tallow, with a featureless lumpen head bearing a blank, mournful face, two drooping arms and no visible legs, its lower body merging into a sagging mass that drags across the ground. It shuffles forward toward the right, one arm reaching out, at the head of a crowd of identical lemures receding into smoky distance. Setting: a scorched basalt plain of Avernus with rivers of lava and dark red clouds. Eerie and pitiful rather than gruesome; no gore, no exposed flesh wounds.

HUGE (body ~12 m long, its head about as long as a person is tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult black dragon surfaces silently from the black water of a flooded underground cistern in a ruined city: glossy black scales with a faint oily sheen, a gaunt skull-like head with deep-set glowing eyes, two thick horns curving forward beside its jaws, leathery wings half-raised and dripping, a long tail trailing under the surface. Only its head, neck, shoulders and forelegs have risen; water streams off its jaws, which hang open with a thin drool of hissing acid falling into the water and raising wisps of steam. Two adventurers seen from behind on a crumbling stone walkway at the lower right raise a lantern and a crossbow. Setting: drowned colonnades, cold lantern light reflecting off ripples, green-black gloom. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head alone is roughly as long as an adventurer is tall, and its raised shoulders stand about three times an adventurer's height above the water.

HUGE (body ~12 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult green dragon coils around the top of a crumbling elven watchtower that rises out of a misty forest canopy at dawn: emerald green scales shading to yellow-green on the belly, a tall leaf-like crest running from its head down its spine, a frilled jaw, two swept-back horns, two broad wings folded against the stone, a long tail wrapped twice around the tower. It lowers its head toward a rope bridge at the lower right, jaws parted as if mid-sentence in sly conversation, thin wisps of green poisonous vapor curling from its nostrils and teeth. Two adventurers seen from behind stand on the bridge, one with a drawn sword, one with a raised hand in parley. Setting: pale golden dawn light through mist, treetops fading into parchment haze. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head is about as long as an adventurer is tall, and its coiled body is about as wide as the tower itself.

HUGE (shell ~6 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An archelon, a prehistoric giant sea turtle, breaches the surface of a sunlit turquoise lagoon: a broad leathery dark gray-green carapace with a low ridged keel, a massive head with a sharply hooked parrot-like beak, four long paddle-shaped flippers (two large front, two smaller rear), barnacles crusting the shell edges. Its head and the front of its shell burst out of the water in a snapping lunge beside a small wooden rowboat at the lower right, where one adventurer seen from behind grips an oar raised like a staff. Camera just above the water at eye level, NO split view: the boat and the turtle float on ONE continuous sea surface that runs across the whole image at the same height, the boat's hull sitting in that surface with its waterline visible; below the surface the turtle's flippers show only as dark shapes through the clear turquoise water, spray and foam where shell and head break through.
