Four flippers, one head. SCALE CHECK: the turtle's shell is about as long as the rowboat and roughly three and a half times as long as the adventurer is tall.

HUGE (about 9 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An awakened tree, an ordinary gnarled old oak brought to life by druidic magic, tears its roots free from the earth at the edge of a village green: rough furrowed gray-brown bark, a vaguely face-like knot of bark with two deep hollows and a split mouth, two thick lower branches bending like arms, a broad crown of autumn leaves shaking loose. It swings one heavy branch in a sweeping slam that smashes a wooden fence into splinters, clods of soil falling from its walking roots. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right brace, an axe and a shield ready. Setting: thatched cottages, a stone well, golden late-afternoon light with drifting leaves. Not a treant: no beard, no humanoid legs, roots as feet. SCALE CHECK: the tree is about five times as tall as an adventurer and about twice the height of the cottages.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A bandit crime lord, an original middle-aged half-orc woman with gray-streaked braids, a scarred jaw and a calm cold gaze, wearing a dark brocade waistcoat over a loose shirt, a long burgundy coat, rings on her fingers and a flintlock pistol tucked into a silk sash. In a smugglers' warehouse lit by a single hanging lantern, she slowly draws a curved scimitar from its scabbard; the blade glistens with a sickly green sheen of poison. Behind her in the shadows, henchmen stack contraband crates and a ledger lies open on a barrel. Setting: dockside warehouse at night, ropes, barrels, mist drifting in from an open river door. Two arms, two legs; menacing composure rather than action.

LARGE (about 2.7 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A barlgura, an apelike demon of the Abyss: a hulking orangutan-shaped body with coarse reddish-orange fur, very long powerful arms reaching nearly to the ground, short bowed legs, a broad flat face with small burning yellow eyes and two upturned tusks jutting from the lower jaw. It is mid-leap between two jagged rock pillars, arms flung wide and mouth roaring, about to crash down on the ground before an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge who raises a shield and a mace. Setting: a blasted reddish wasteland of the Abyss with jagged stone spires and a sickly orange sky. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the barlgura is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A blue slaad bounds across the shattered ground of Limbo: a hunched, upright toad-like humanoid with mottled pale-blue and slate-gray skin, a wide froglike mouth full of teeth, large bulging eyes, and from the back of each hand a long curved bony hook-claw. It slashes one hook-claw through the air in a wide arc, raking deep gouges into a floating boulder as it lands, while it glares at an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge who backs away with a raised spear. Setting: chaotic soup of drifting islands of earth, globes of water and flickers of fire under a swirling violet sky; different from the red slaad scene. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the slaad is about one and three quarter times as tall as the adventurer.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long, a young dragon). SOLO. A brass dragon wyrmling on a sun-baked desert mesa at noon: a young dragon with burnished golden-brass scales, a broad smooth head plate shaped like a flared shield on the back of its skull, a small pointed chin horn, two wings with tan membranes, a long tail. It sits up on its haunches and exhales a drifting cloud of shimmering pale sleep gas toward the right, where a curious desert fox has slumped asleep beside a cactus, while the wyrmling tilts its head with mischievous delight. Setting: red sandstone formations, heat haze, a half-buried clay pot and a traveler's abandoned sandal for scale. Four legs, two wings, one head.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m long, as big as a large dog). SOLO. A bulette pup bursts up out of loose gravel in an abandoned hillside quarry: a compact armored juvenile with gray-blue overlapping plates, a blunt shark-like head with a wide jaw of jagged teeth, a stubby dorsal crest along its back and four short thick legs with spade-like digging claws. It leaps forward in a clumsy, hungry pounce at a toppled mine cart, gravel and dust spraying from the hole behind it. Setting: pale stone quarry walls, a rusty pickaxe and a wooden ladder for scale, afternoon light. Four legs, one head.

LARGE (about 2 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A bad-tempered dromedary camel on a desert caravan trail at dusk: sandy-tan shaggy coat, a single hump, long curved neck, heavy-lidded eyes, split upper lip pulled back to bare yellow teeth. It swings its head toward the right with ears pinned back, groaning and lips foaming, ready to bite, while its loosened saddle packs and woven blankets slip from its back. At the lower right edge an adventurer seen from behind holds the lead rope taut and raises a hand to calm it. Setting: wind-rippled dunes, a line of camels in the distance, warm orange sunset haze. Four legs, one hump, one head. SCALE CHECK: the camel's shoulder is a little higher than the adventurer's head.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A cultist, an original young man of mixed heritage with a shaved head and nervous fervent eyes, wearing a plain undyed brown hooded robe belted with a rope, a crude carved bone amulet on a cord (no symbols). In a forest clearing at night, he kneels before a ring of weathered standing stones and lifts a curved iron ritual sickle high in one hand, chanting, while a pale greenish light flickers from a small fire pit before him. Other hooded figures stand among the stones in the gloom behind. Setting: dark pines, moonlit mist, sparks rising. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 3.5 m tall). SOLO. A dao, a genie of elemental earth, rises out of a cavern floor deep in the Plane of Earth: a massive brawny figure with rough dark-gray stony skin veined with gold, glittering gemstones set into its brow and forearms, a proud heavy face with a braided black beard ringed with gold, golden armbands and a jeweled girdle, its lower body a churning column of rock and sand instead of legs. It swings a huge two-handed maul of solid stone low and sideways like a woodsman swinging an axe, the handle held diagonally across its body at hip height, one hand near the end of the handle and the other higher up, both wrists straight and the knuckles of both hands facing outward, and the stone head strikes the cavern floor to the right so that it erupts in a fountain of shattered rock. The maul is NOT held overhead. Setting: a vast crystal-studded cavern with veins of glowing ore and heaps of gold. Two arms, one head, earthen column below the waist; arrogant and imperious.

SMALL (wingspan about 2 m). SOLO. A golden eagle swoops down on a windswept mountain cliff at morning: dark brown plumage with golden-bronze nape feathers, a hooked yellow beak, fierce amber eyes, wings fully spread and thrown back, yellow talons extended forward to strike. It drops onto a hare bolting across a lichen-covered boulder at the lower right, the moment just before the strike. Setting: a jagged rocky ridge, a twisted pine, distant blue valleys; a weathered walking staff leaning against the rock for scale. Two wings, two legs.

LARGE (about 1.8 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant boar charges through an autumn oak forest: bristly dark-brown coarse fur, a high hunched shoulder ridge, small furious red eyes, long curved ivory tusks, mud caked on its flanks. It barrels forward with its head lowered, kicking up leaves and mud, toward a hunter seen from behind at the lower right edge who braces a boar spear with a crossbar against the ground. Setting: fallen leaves, acorns, misty beech and oak trunks, low morning light. Four legs, one head, two tusks. SCALE CHECK: the boar's shoulder reaches the adventurer's chin.

LARGE (about 1.5 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant hyena lopes out of the dusk across a scrubland of thornbushes: a sloping back, powerful forequarters, spotted gray-tan fur, a bristling dark mane along its neck, rounded ears, a massive bone-crushing jaw open in a cackling laugh. Two more giant hyenas circle in the dust behind it. It rushes toward an overturned supply wagon at the lower right where an adventurer seen from behind lifts a burning torch and a short sword. Setting: thorny acacia scrub, dust haze, purple twilight with the first stars. Four legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the hyena's shoulder is about at the adventurer's chest height.

LARGE (about 2.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant toad squats on a mossy log in a reed marsh at night: warty mottled olive-brown and ochre skin, a pale speckled throat, huge golden eyes with horizontal pupils, a wide mouth. It shoots out its long sticky pink tongue toward the right, snapping it around a fat marsh duck in the air, while an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge on a narrow plank walkway raises a lantern and a short sword. Setting: cattails, lily pads, fireflies, cold moonlight on dark water. Four legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the toad's back is about as high as the adventurer's waist, and its body about one and a half times the adventurer's height in length.

MEDIUM (body as big as a large dog). SOLO. A giant wolf spider stalks over sunlit stony grassland: a hairy body with brown, gray and black striped patterns, a large front row of eyes with two big forward-facing eyes shining, eight long hairy legs, two short palps and dark fangs. It crouches low, legs bunched, in the instant before it springs from a rocky burrow entrance toward a fleeing field mouse to the right. Setting: dry grass, scattered stones, a dropped leather backpack and a waterskin for scale, warm late-afternoon light. Exactly eight legs, eight eyes, no web.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A githzerai psion hovers cross-legged above a windswept mountain pass at dawn: a lean ascetic humanoid with pale yellow skin, a gaunt face with sunken intense eyes, long pointed swept-back ears, a shaved head with a long topknot braid, wearing layered rust-colored and gray robes with wrapped forearms. Eyes glowing faintly, it extends both palms toward the right, and a cluster of boulders, a broken cart wheel and loose stones lifts into the air around it, warping and twisting in shimmering violet psionic distortion. Setting: craggy snowy peaks, prayer-flag-like strips of cloth (no symbols) fluttering, cold dawn light; not a monastery. Two arms, two legs, one head; serene and focused.

MEDIUM (about 2.3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gnoll fang of Yeenoghu, a demon-touched gnoll, stalks through a burning ruined watchtower at night: a lanky hyena-headed humanoid with darker, blood-red tinted spotted fur, a mane of stiff black bristles, glowing red eyes, crude armor of hides and bone plates, a necklace of fangs. It whirls a long bone flail (a haft with chains ending in jagged bone spikes) overhead, jaws open in a howling cackle, poison-green drool dripping from its fangs. At the lower right edge an adventurer seen from behind braces behind a round shield. Setting: firelight, smoke, a collapsed palisade, starless night; different from the savanna gnoll scene. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the gnoll is about one and a third times as tall as the adventurer.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A goblin hexer crouches on a tree stump in a dim, mushroom-filled forest hollow: a small wiry fey goblin with green-gray skin, a long pointed nose, large pointed ears pierced with copper rings, wide yellow eyes, wearing a patched hooded cloak covered in feathers, twigs and little bone charms. It points a crooked knobbly hex stick toward the right, and a twisting thread of sickly violet light curls from its tip, while faint glowing motes of faerie fire drift around a nearby snare. Setting: giant toadstools, roots, a dropped coin purse and a lantern for scale, cold blue twilight. Two arms, two legs, one head; sly grin.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A guard captain, an original stout dwarf woman with weathered tan skin, a short braided auburn beard-like sideburns and a stern focused look, wearing a polished breastplate over chain mail, a dark blue tabard (no emblem), a plumed open-faced helm and a longsword at her hip. On a city wall walkway at sunset she sets her stance and draws back a javelin to throw toward the right, her other hand pointing commands to two guards behind her. Setting: crenellated stone battlements, banners, the rooftops of a walled city below, orange evening sky. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (about 2 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A half-dragon of white dragon descent strides across a frozen glacier: a tall muscular humanoid covered in pale ice-white and frost-blue scales, a draconic head with a short snout and a crown of swept-back horns, slit blue eyes, a long tail, clawed hands and feet, no wings, wearing a fur-trimmed harness and bracers. It rears back and exhales a cone of glittering frost toward the right, freezing the ice ridge in front of an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, who braces behind a shield. Setting: blue ice cliffs, blowing snow, pale midday sun. Two arms, two legs, one tail, one head, no wings. SCALE CHECK: the half-dragon is only slightly taller than the adventurer.

GARGANTUAN (an animated manor house about 15 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A haunting revenant, the vengeful spirit of a murdered noble bound into her own derelict manor house, which heaves itself up from the moor: a gabled, ivy-strangled stone house with sagging roofs and broken shutters, its dark windows burning with a cold blue-green ghostly light arranged like two eyes, its great front door gaping like a mouth. A pale translucent figure in a tattered gown leans out of the doorway with one arm outstretched in beckoning invitation, while chairs, roof slates and a chandelier whirl through the air around the house. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right hold their ground on the cracked garden path, one raising a holy symbol. Setting: a fog-bound moor at midnight under a gibbous moon, dead trees. Eerie, not gory. SCALE CHECK: the front door is about twice the height of an adventurer and the house towers about nine times their height.

LARGE (about 4.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A hunter shark knifes through a sunlit shallow reef: sleek gray-bronze back, white belly, a tall triangular dorsal fin, black eyes, a blunt snout and rows of serrated teeth. It turns sharply, jaws open, toward a school of silver fish scattering to the right, while above at the water surface the hull of a small canoe floats and one adventurer seen from behind leans over its edge with a raised spear. Underwater view with the surface visible above, light rays, coral heads. One dorsal fin, two pectoral fins, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: the shark is about two and a half times as long as the adventurer is tall.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m tall). SOLO. A kenku, a flightless crow-like humanoid with glossy black feathers, a sharp black beak, dark glinting eyes and stubby vestigial wings under a hooded patched charcoal cloak, scrawny clawed bird feet. In a narrow city alley at night it holds up an iron lantern that spills a shimmering eerie violet light across the cobblestones, outlining a lurking cutpurse's silhouette in the glow, and draws back a blade made of solid shadow to throw toward the right; its beak is open, mimicking a guard's whistle. Setting: wet cobblestones, laundry lines, shuttered windows, a cat on a barrel for scale. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A kuo-toa archpriest presides over a flooded sea-cave temple built inside the wreck of a capsized ship: a fish-like humanoid with slick blue-gray scales, a large fish head with bulging round eyes and a wide lipless mouth, wearing a towering headdress of shells, fishbones and polished brass scraps, a cloak of tattered sailcloth and kelp. It raises a strange twisted scepter of coral and copper whose tip crackles with branching blue lightning toward the right, while a faint shimmering ward of faith surrounds it. Kneeling kuo-toa worshippers chant in the shallow water behind. Setting: barnacled ship ribs, glowing green bioluminescence, dark tide pools. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m long). SOLO, but in a writhing heap. A larva, the wretched soul of a wicked mortal reborn in the Lower Planes: a pale, swollen grub-like worm body with soft yellowish-gray ridged segments, ending at the front in a small, shriveled human face with a mournful, hungry expression and tiny round mouth. It rears its front end up toward the right from a heap of other larvae crawling over each other in a shallow pit. Setting: a gray ashen plain of the Hades wasteland, a cracked stone basin, dull colorless light and drifting ash. Eerie and pitiful rather than grotesque; no gore.

TINY (about 30 cm long). SOLO. A close-up of an ordinary wall lizard basking belly-down on top of a sun-warmed stone ledge in desert ruins, right side up with all four feet on the stone, its head raised toward the right: slender body with olive and ochre speckled scales, a long tapering tail, four splayed toes-gripping legs, a small head with bright beady eyes, mouth open as it snaps at a passing beetle. Setting: crumbling sandstone, a dropped copper coin and a clay oil lamp on the ledge below for scale, bright midday light and crisp shadows. Four legs, one tail.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A lizardfolk geomancer stands on a mud island in a misty cypress swamp: a reptilian humanoid with dark green and ochre-banded scales, a long crocodilian snout, a ridge of short spines on the head, a thick tail, wearing a mantle of moss and strings of polished river stones and turtle shells. It raises a gnarled staff with one clawed hand and calls down a hail of stones from a churning circle in the air, chunks of rock hammering into the water and an abandoned raft to the right, sending up splashes. Setting: hanging moss, gray morning fog, water birds fleeing. Two arms, two legs, one tail, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A merfolk wavebender rises from a breaking wave beside a black-rock sea stack: upper body of an original merfolk woman with deep teal skin, long dark hair tangled with pearls and kelp, shell armlets and a coral circlet, her lower body a long silver-green fish tail. She sweeps both hands up and to the right, and a great curling wall of foaming seawater rises at her command, a burst of icy spray exploding from its crest against the rocks. Setting: a stormy coast at dusk, gulls, a distant lighthouse. Two arms, one tail, one head.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m tall). SOLO. A modron duodrone marches in a perfectly ordered line of identical duodrones across a gear-covered bronze plain of Mechanus: a rectangular brick-shaped body of smooth bronze-gray metal with a simple flat face of two round eyes and a straight mouth on its front, two jointed arms and two short legs, no wings. It hurls a spinning toothed clockwork blade toward the right, the blade trailing a faint shimmer of force as it flies. Setting: enormous turning cogwheels in the sky, geometric terraces, even shadowless golden light. Two arms, two legs, one face.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A needle blight lurches out of a dark pine forest at night: a gaunt hunched humanoid shape made of tangled conifer branches and dead wood, its body bristling with long dark-green needles like a porcupine, gnarled twig fingers, a featureless knotty head with a faint sap-glow in two hollows. It flings a volley of stiff needles from its outstretched arm toward the right, the needles thudding into a tree trunk. Several more blights shamble among the trunks behind. Setting: dense pines, moonlight through branches, a dropped lantern in the needles. Two arms, two legs; not the small twig blight.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A noble, an original elegant elf man with warm brown skin, a sharp goatee and silver-streaked hair tied back, wearing a fitted emerald velvet doublet with slashed sleeves, a lace collar and fine gloves. In a candle-lit ballroom gallery, he executes a crisp parry with a slim rapier, deflecting an unseen opponent's blade that enters only as a gleam from the right edge, his other hand held elegantly behind his back, expression faintly bored. Setting: chandeliers, tall mirrors, marble floor, guests in the blurred background. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An ogrillon ogre, an ogre of orc descent, charges down a muddy hill trail: a hulking brute with gray-green skin, a heavy brow, small piggish eyes, jutting lower tusks, coarse black hair tied in a topknot, wearing a crude studded hide jerkin and fur boots. It hurls a javelin toward the right with one arm while gripping a battle-axe in the other, the javelin flying wide past a wooden signpost. At the lower right edge an adventurer seen from behind raises a shield. Setting: rain, gray hills, a burnt-out farmstead in the distance; different from the forest ogre scene. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the ogrillon is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

TINY (about 30 cm long). SOLO. A close-up underwater of a single piranha in a murky jungle river: a deep-bodied silvery-gray fish with a bright red-orange belly and throat, a blunt head, a protruding lower jaw with a row of razor-sharp triangular teeth. It darts toward the right, mouth open, at a dangling piece of meat on a fishing hook. Setting: tangled submerged roots, floating leaves on the surface above, green-gold light filtering down; a dropped iron dagger on the riverbed for scale. Two pectoral fins, one tail.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A pirate, an original wiry tiefling woman with dusky red skin, short curling horns, a gold earring and a wide grin, wearing a sea-stained white shirt, a crimson sash, a leather vest and tall boots, a bandana over her hair. She swings across the deck of a pitching ship on a rope from the rigging, one hand holding the rope and the other flourishing a dagger with dazzling showmanship, her free leg kicked out. Setting: billowing sails, ropes, sea spray, crewmates cheering behind, golden afternoon sun over a blue sea. Two arms, two legs, one tail.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A planetar, a mighty angel, alights on the shattered steps of a besieged mountain monastery: a towering, broad-shouldered figure with smooth emerald-green skin, a bald head, glowing white eyes, wearing gleaming silver-white plate armor and a white tabard (no symbols), and two enormous white feathered wings spread wide. It raises a massive radiant greatsword in both hands and releases a burst of blinding holy light that blasts outward from the blade into the dark sky, dispelling shadows. An adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge kneels with a bowed head and a shield. Setting: storm clouds splitting open, golden rays, broken stone archways. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the planetar is about one and three quarter times as tall as the adventurer stands.

TINY (about 60 cm wingspan). SOLO. A close-up of a raven perched on the edge of a weathered gallows post at a lonely crossroads: glossy blue-black feathers, a thick curved black beak, shaggy throat feathers, clever dark eyes. It flaps its wings half-open and caws, beak wide, as if mimicking a voice, while tugging at a dropped shiny coin on a leather pouch below it. Setting: a misty autumn crossroads with a wooden signpost, gray overcast light. Two wings, two legs; a hand-sized coin for scale.

LARGE (about 2.7 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A sahuagin baron reigns from a coral throne in a sunken temple: a huge fiendish fish-like humanoid with dark blue-green scales, a paler belly, a tall spiny dorsal fin from head to tail, a broad shark-toothed mouth, black eyes and webbed clawed hands and feet, wearing a crown of coral and shark teeth and a sash of gold chains. It thrusts a heavy barbed trident toward the right while three sharks circle obediently around it. An adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge, in a diving helmet, hovers in the water with a raised spear. Underwater, shafts of light from far above, ruined columns. Two arms, two legs, one tail fin, one head. SCALE CHECK: the baron is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

TINY (about 30 cm tall). SOLO. A sprite, a tiny fey warrior with silvery-lavender skin, pointed ears, large dark eyes and translucent dragonfly-like wings, wearing armor of bark and leaf and a tiny cloak of moth wing. She hovers beside a giant foxglove flower in an ancient forest glade, drawing a tiny shortbow and aiming toward the right, a faint shimmer of enchantment around the arrow tip. Dewdrops, a ladybug on a leaf and a human-sized dropped glove nearby for scale. Setting: dappled morning sunlight, soft green moss. Two arms, two legs, two pairs of wings.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A spy master, an original lithe middle-aged human woman with dark skin, close-cropped gray hair and a sharp watchful gaze, wearing a dark leather coat with hidden pockets, a slim rapier at her hip and a hand crossbow strapped to her forearm. On a moonlit slate rooftop, she has just tossed a smoke bomb that explodes into a thick billowing cloud of greenish-gray smoke on the right, and she leaps away across the gap to the next roof in a crouched spring. Setting: chimneys, a bell tower, a sleeping city under starry sky. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (a swarm covering about 3 x 3 m). SOLO. A swarm of larvae, dozens of pale, swollen grub-like worms each with a small shriveled human face, pours over each other in a crawling wave down a crumbling stone stair in the Lower Planes, their mournful faces turned upward. The mass flows toward the right over an abandoned iron helm and a broken lantern that serve for scale. Setting: an ash-gray wasteland under dull sickly light, cracked stone and drifting cinders. Eerie and pitiful rather than grotesque; no gore.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering about 1.5 x 1.5 m). SOLO. A swarm of piranhas churns the surface of a jungle river into white frothing foam: dozens of silvery fish with red-orange bellies and bared triangular teeth leap and thrash out of the water around a dangling haunch of meat lowered from a rope. Half-underwater view showing the mass of fish below the surface, the churning frenzy above. Setting: mangrove roots, hanging vines, steamy green light; a wooden canoe paddle floating nearby for scale.

MEDIUM (about 2 m tall). SOLO. A thri-kreen psion hovers above glittering salt flats under two moons at night: an insectoid humanoid with pale sandy-gray chitin, a mantis-like head with large faceted eyes and long antennae, mandibles, four arms and two legs. Floating a meter above the ground in a meditative stance, it extends two of its hands toward the right and a long shimmering lance of violet psionic energy streaks out, piercing a jagged salt crag, while its other two hands are held together before its chest. Setting: crystalline salt pillars reflecting moonlight, deep blue night sky. Exactly four arms, two legs, one head; different from the desert marauder scene.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A vampire umbral lord stands atop a ruined bell tower above a sleeping town at midnight: a gaunt, ancient vampire with ash-gray skin, hollow cheeks, sharp fangs, eyes like burning red embers, long white hair, wearing a tattered black mantle that dissolves into living shadow at the edges. It raises one clawed hand and conjures a sphere of absolute darkness in the street below to the right, from which faint shadowy tentacles reach up into the air. At the lower right on a lower rooftop, an adventurer seen from behind raises a glowing lantern and a holy symbol. Setting: cracked bell, crows, a cold full moon behind thin clouds; different from the vampire staircase scene. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the vampire is about the same height as the adventurer.

LARGE (about 1.7 m at the shoulder). SOLO. A warhorse rears on a trampled battlefield: a massive heavy-boned destrier with a glossy dark bay coat, a long black mane flying, feathered hooves, wearing a leather barding with steel chanfron and a red-and-ochre caparison (no heraldry), an empty saddle. It rears up with front hooves flailing high, eyes wide and nostrils flared, toward a toppled siege banner pole on the right. Setting: smoky field, broken lances, low sunset light. Four legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A warrior infantry soldier, an original stocky orc man with olive-gray skin, short tusks and a determined frown, wearing a padded gambeson, a round iron cap helm and a painted wooden round shield (plain colors, no emblem). He stands in the front line of a shield wall of other soldiers of mixed peoples, levelling a long spear forward toward the right, shoulder to shoulder with his comrades. Setting: a muddy field with morning mist, banners and spear tips behind. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 3 m tall when rising). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A water weird rises out of a sacred fountain in a ruined temple courtyard: a coiling serpent shape formed entirely of clear, rippling water, with only faint eyes of reflected light and a hint of a serpentine head, its lower body still flowing from the fountain basin. It lashes forward in a cold, splashing surge toward the right, spray freezing in the air, just short of an adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge who stops with a raised torch. Setting: cracked marble, moss, moonlight glimmering through the water's body. SCALE CHECK: the water weird's coiled body rises about one and three quarter times the adventurer's height.

LARGE (body ~5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young blue dragon bursts up out of a sand dune in ambush at the mouth of a red-rock canyon at dusk: cobalt-blue scales with a paler underbelly, a single large horn on its snout, smaller swept-back horns framing its head, two wings flinging off cascades of sand, a long tail. Crackling blue lightning arcs between its nose horn and the stormy sky as it opens its jaws toward the right, about to unleash its lightning breath into a sandstone outcrop. An adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge braces with a spear. Setting: wind-whipped sand, canyon walls, purple storm clouds. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's body is about three times as long as the adventurer is tall and its raised head about one and a half times the adventurer's height.

LARGE (body ~5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young red dragon clings to the battlement of a ruined snow-dusted mountain fortress at sunset: vivid scarlet scales, two swept-back horns, a spiky frill along the jaw, two wings spread wide, a long spiked tail curled around a tower. It breathes a roaring jet of fire down onto a heavy wooden portcullis gate below to the right, setting it ablaze. An adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge crouches behind a snowy rampart with a shield raised. Setting: snowy peaks, orange-red sunset light, smoke rising. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's body is about three times as long as the adventurer is tall and its raised head about one and a half times the adventurer's height.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A yuan-ti malison type 2 stands in a jungle temple ruin: a humanoid with a human head and torso with faintly scaled jade-and-ochre skin, slitted golden eyes and a coiled headdress, but its two arms are long hissing snakes instead of human arms, each ending in a fanged snake head. It lunges toward the right with both snake-arms striking, fangs dripping venom, while its human face smiles coldly. Setting: carved stone pillars, vines, the setting sun streaming through a collapsed roof. Two snake arms, two legs, one human head.

HUGE (body ~15 m long, its head about as long as an adventurer is tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult blue dragon bursts up out of the sand of a moonlit salt flat where it lay buried in ambush: deep sapphire-blue scales with paler blue underside, ONE large forward-curving horn on its snout, a frill of swept-back horns around its head, two great batlike wings snapping open, a long spined tail. Sand pours off its back as it rears and spits a crackling straight line of white-blue lightning from its open mouth into a lone sandstone spire to the right, which explodes into shards. Two adventurers seen from behind crouch on a cracked salt crust at the lower right, shields raised. Setting: night, pale moon, white salt crust, distant mesas, static sparks crawling over its horns. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's body is about nine times as long as an adventurer is tall, its raised head roughly three adventurers above the ground.

HUGE (body ~15 m long, its head about as long as an adventurer is tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult red dragon lands with crushing weight on the broken battlements of a ruined hilltop keep at sunset: glossy crimson scales darkening toward the edges, two swept-back horns, a spiked jaw frill, a ridge of spines down its back, two vast batlike wings half-spread, a long tail curled over the wall. Talons gouging the masonry, it blasts a roaring cone of fire from its open mouth down onto an empty stone courtyard to the right, setting a siege engine ablaze. Two adventurers seen from behind stand their ground in a gatehouse arch at the lower right, weapons drawn. Setting: orange sunset, smoke, embers, crumbling towers. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's body spans roughly nine adventurer heights; its head is about the size of one adventurer.

MEDIUM (human-sized, tall and regal). SOLO. An animal lord, a celestial embodiment of all great cats: a tall lithe humanoid figure with tawny golden fur, a lion-like face with a short dark mane, feline ears, glowing amber eyes, clawed hands and digitigrade legs, wearing a simple belted tunic of woven leaves and a circlet of living vines. It leaps forward through the air toward the right, one hand raised and summoning a translucent radiant spirit panther that bounds out ahead of it trailing golden light, while ordinary jungle animals (a leopard, parrots, a monkey) watch from the branches. Setting: sun-dappled jungle clearing at golden hour, shafts of light through mist. Two arms, two legs, one head; majestic, not monstrous.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An arch-hag, the queen of all hags, towers in a lightning-lit witch-grove: an impossibly tall, gaunt crone with gray-green bark-like skin, a long hooked nose, burning green eyes, a mane of wild silver hair woven with bones and thorny twigs, a crown of twisted black branches, long clawed fingers and layered ragged robes of moss, feathers and stolen lace. She sweeps one clawed hand forward and unleashes a crackling fan-shaped wave of green-white lightning that tears across the soggy ground to the right, while a spectral glowing claw hovers beside her. A single adventurer seen from behind braces behind a standing stone at the lower right. Setting: a ring of dead oaks under a storm, cauldron smoke, hanging charms. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the hag stands about one and three-quarter times as tall as the adventurer.

SMALL (about knee-to-thigh height of a human). SOLO. A baboon on a rocky outcrop at dawn: an olive-brown furred monkey with a long doglike muzzle, close-set amber eyes, a hairless pinkish-gray face and rump, and a curved tail. It bares long yellowed canine fangs in a screaming threat display toward the right, hunched on all fours, while two more baboons climb up behind it. A traveler's dropped leather satchel and a spilled water gourd lie on the rocks in front of it as scale cues. Setting: sun-bleached savanna boulders, an acacia, dusty golden light. Four limbs, one tail, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A bandit deceiver, a cunning illusionist-rogue: a wiry half-elf woman in her forties with dark braided hair, a chameleon-like long coat whose colors seem to shift, a scarf half over her face, belts of throwing daggers. In a candlelit roadside tavern she flicks two daggers from her fingers toward the right while her other hand snaps open in a blinding white flash of light, and a shimmering illusory double of her steps out sideways from her silhouette. Setting: overturned tables, scattered cards and coins, warm lamplight broken by the burst. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A bearded devil, a barbazu soldier of the Nine Hells: a lean humanoid devil with rust-red scaly skin, pointed ears, a long reptilian tail, clawed hands and feet, and a writhing beard of snaky barbed tendrils on its chin. It charges forward along a cracked infernal causeway with a saw-toothed glaive held in both hands, the blade's edge glowing, beard-tendrils lashing. A single adventurer seen from behind sets a shield at the lower right edge. Setting: Avernus battlefield with a red sky, distant iron fortress, drifting ash. Two arms, two legs, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: devil and adventurer are about the same height.

MEDIUM (about waist height to a human, heavy). SOLO. A wild boar charges out of a frost-covered beech forest at first light: a massive bristly dark-brown pig with a high hump of shoulders, a ridge of stiff hair along its spine, small furious eyes, and two curved ivory tusks jutting from its lower jaw. It thunders toward the right through the leaf litter, snorting steam, a fallen hunting spear trampled underfoot and a broken fence rail in front of it as scale cues. Setting: misty winter woods, pale low sun, frozen ferns. Four legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long, a young dragon). WITH ONE ADVENTURER for scale. A bronze dragon wyrmling in a sea cave at low tide: a young dragon with gleaming bronze scales, a ridged frill along its jaw, small swept-back horns, webbed claws, two wings held half-open and a finned tail. Perched on a barnacled rock, it exhales a shimmering pulse of repelling force from its open mouth that blows a wave and a tangle of driftwood backward away from it toward the right. A single adventurer seen from behind wades ankle-deep at the lower right edge, holding up a lantern. Setting: green-gold light through the cave mouth, tide pools, wet seaweed. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the wyrmling's body is about as long as the adventurer is tall.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A cockatrice regent, a monstrous elder cockatrice: the head, body and powerful scaly legs of a giant rooster, a tall jagged crimson comb like a crown and a heavy red wattle, two broad leathery batlike wings and a long scaly serpent tail. It swoops low over a ruined temple garden full of half-petrified statues, wings spread, beak open in a screech, talons swinging forward toward the right. A single adventurer seen from behind ducks behind a stone birdbath at the lower right edge. Setting: overgrown cloister, late afternoon dust, grey stone animals. Two legs, two wings, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: the regent stands about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

LARGE (about 3 m long). SOLO. A constrictor snake in a mangrove swamp: a thick-bodied python with glossy olive and tan blotched scales, a broad head with heat-sensing pits and amber slit-pupil eyes. It hangs in heavy coils from a mangrove root over brown water and lunges its open mouth toward the right at a wading heron that flaps up in alarm. A moored dugout canoe below gives scale. Setting: humid green dusk, hanging roots, fireflies. No legs, one head.

SMALL (about the size of a large dog, a 1 m mantle). SOLO. A darkmantle drops from the ceiling of a dripping cave: a squidlike creature with a rubbery dark gray-brown conical body that looked like a stalactite a moment ago, now flaring open a webbed mantle between EIGHT tentacles into an umbrella shape, with tiny eyes near the top. As it falls, a sphere of unnatural blackness spreads from it and swallows the light of a lantern that hangs from a peg on the right. Setting: a narrow cave passage with real stalactites around it, a dropped pickaxe and a coil of rope on the ground for scale.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A death cultist presiding in a bone-lined crypt chapel: a gaunt dark-skinned man with a shaved head painted with a pale skull, sunken eyes, layered black and bone-white vestments and a necklace of finger bones. He raises a long black-bladed scythe in one hand and thrusts the other forward, firing a ray of crackling sickly green-black necrotic energy into a toppling candelabrum to the right, while ghostly wailing faces swirl around him. Setting: skull niches, guttering candles, cold green light. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character, no gore.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A dust mephit swirls over a ruined desert tomb: a scrawny impish creature of gray-brown dusty skin, thin bony limbs, two dry tattered insectlike wings, a sharp chin and sneering face with pale glowing eyes, its body trailing sand. It hovers and spits a cloud of stinging blinding grit from its mouth toward the right over a cracked clay jar and a fallen lantern that give scale. Setting: sun-baked tomb entrance, dust haze, harsh noon light. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (a floating sphere about 1.5 m across). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gas spore drifts down a dim dungeon corridor: a bloated gray fungal sphere covered in leathery blotchy skin, with ONE large blind milky eye-like spot in the center and a ring of thin limp stalks on top that mimic eyestalks, faint dangling tendrils beneath. Clouds of fine pale spores puff from its surface. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge freezes with a torch held back, recognizing it is not what it seems. Setting: wet flagstones, an iron door, sickly greenish torchlight. SCALE CHECK: the sphere is about as wide as the adventurer is tall.

MEDIUM (shell about 1.2 m wide). SOLO. A giant crab rises out of the surf on a rocky beach at sunset: a broad armored shell of mottled red-orange and barnacle-crusted brown, two eyes on short stalks, EIGHT jointed walking legs and two large serrated pincers. It rears up on its hind legs with both claws raised high and open toward the right, a wrecked rowboat and a lobster trap beside it as scale cues. Setting: tide spray, wet black rocks, pink-gold sky. Two claws, eight legs.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant lizard clings sideways to the wall of a sandstone canyon: a monitor-like reptile with rough grayish-green scales banded with ochre, a long tail, a heavy jaw and a flicking forked tongue. It scuttles down the vertical rock face toward the right, jaws open with a hiss, its claws gripping the stone. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge holds a spear ready on the canyon floor. Setting: hot afternoon light, shadowed slot canyon. Four legs, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: the lizard's body is about one and three-quarter times as long as the adventurer is tall.

MEDIUM (about 3 m long, slender). SOLO. A giant venomous snake rears its head out of the ruins of a sunken jungle shrine: a long slender viper with banded black, yellow and rust-red scales, a triangular head, slit-pupiled eyes and long dripping fangs. It coils on a mossy fallen pillar and strikes toward the right with its mouth gaping wide, venom glistening on its fangs. A dropped explorer's pith helmet and a toppled clay urn on the stones give scale. Setting: steamy green shade, broken carvings without glyphs, hanging lianas. No legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A githzerai zerth, a master of mind and body: a lean ascetic humanoid with yellowish skin, a gaunt angular face with sunken eyes, long pointed ears, a topknot of dark hair, wearing layered gray and deep-blue monastic wraps with bound forearms. It soars in a psionically powered leap across a gap between two floating rocks, legs tucked, one fist drawn back and glowing with violet psionic force, an invisible force-shield shimmering before it. Setting: a githzerai fortress-monastery hanging in the swirling chaos of Limbo, tumbling stones and churning colors, cold dawn light. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 2.2 m tall, lanky). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gnoll pack lord leads a night raid on a burning farmstead: a tall hyena-headed humanoid with spotted gray-tan fur, a bristling black mane, a long fanged muzzle and wild yellow eyes, wearing a mantle of hides, a necklace of teeth and a crude bone crown. It cracks a long whip of jointed bones above its head and howls, a bone javelin in its other hand, while silhouetted gnolls rampage behind it. A single adventurer seen from behind stands guard by a well at the lower right edge, sword drawn. Setting: night, a burning barn, smoke and sparks. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the gnoll is about a head taller than the adventurer.

SMALL (about 1 m tall, waist height of a human). SOLO. A goblin minion darts through a cluttered goblin warren: a scrawny small humanoid with yellow-green skin, big pointed ears, a flat nose and a wide grin of small sharp teeth, wearing ragged hide scraps and a dented pot as a helmet. It slides under a crude plank table toward the right, a rusty dagger clutched in one hand and a stolen sausage in the other, glancing back with a nasty grin. Setting: smoky cave lit by a cookfire, human-sized barrels and a stolen wagon wheel as scale cues. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A city guard at a rain-slick town gate at night: a stocky middle-aged dwarven woman with a braided gray beard-tuft of sideburns, a dented steel cap, a chain shirt under a faded tabard in plain red and ochre, a round wooden shield on her back. She steps out from under a lantern and lowers her spear toward the right in a firm challenge, mouth open in a shouted warning. Setting: wet cobblestones, a heavy wooden portcullis, puddles reflecting lantern light. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character.

MEDIUM (about 1 m long, waist height). SOLO. A hyena slinks out of the tall grass at dusk: a sloping-backed dog-like beast with coarse sandy fur covered in dark spots, rounded ears, a bristly mane and powerful jaws. It lowers its head with jaws open in a cackling laugh toward the right, while two more hyenas circle in the grass behind it. A discarded traveler's pack and a bleached ox skull lie on the ground beside it as scale cues. Setting: savanna at dusk, red sky, a lone dead tree. Four legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 2.5 m long, a young dragon). WITH ONE ADVENTURER for scale. A juvenile shadow dragon slips through a moonlit graveyard: a lean young dragon whose dark scales fade into translucent drifting smoke at the edges, pale glowing eyes, small curved horns, two ragged wings and a whiplike tail, half melting into the shadow of a mausoleum. It exhales a cone of swirling black shadow-mist across the tombstones toward the right, snuffing out a lantern on a gravestone. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge raises a sword and a light spell. Setting: moonlit fog, leaning headstones, black yew trees. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's body is about one and a half times as long as the adventurer is tall.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A kuo-toa monitor, a fanatical enforcer: a fish-headed humanoid with slick blue-gray scales, huge bulging round eyes, gill slits and a wide downturned mouth, webbed hands and feet, wearing a harness of bones and shells. It springs forward in a flooded tunnel, lashing a long whip made of vertebrae that crackles with blue lightning along its length, the arcing whip snapping against the wet wall to the right. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge raises a buckler in knee-deep water. Setting: a dripping drainage tunnel in the Underdark, glowing blue fungi, reflections on black water. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the kuo-toa and the adventurer are about the same height.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A lacedon, an aquatic ghoul, swims up through the flooded hold of a sunken ship: a gaunt grayish-blue humanoid with waterlogged wrinkled skin, webbed clawed fingers, a wide mouth of pointed teeth, pale filmy eyes and drifting strands of hair and torn sailcloth rags. It surges toward the right through the murky green water past broken barrels and a ship's lantern, frost-white rime spreading across its jaw, bubbles trailing behind. Setting: shafts of greenish light through a hole in the hull, floating debris, an anchor chain for scale. Two arms, two legs, one head; eerie, not gory.

MEDIUM (about 2 m tall, massive). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A lizardfolk sovereign infused with elemental earth: a broad reptilian humanoid with dark green and bronze scales, a crocodile-like snout full of teeth, a crest of bony spines, a thick tail, wearing a crown of carved stone and bones and a mantle of crocodile hide. It charges out of a swamp, raising a massive stone-headed maul whose head is a living chunk of rock wreathed in crackling earth energy, and slams it into the mud to the right, cracking the ground into a burst of stones. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge braces on a root. Setting: a primeval swamp with stone menhirs, morning mist. Two arms, two legs, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: the sovereign is just slightly taller than the adventurer.

MEDIUM (human-sized, hunched). SOLO. A manes vaporspawn creeps out of a fissure in an Abyssal wasteland: a gaunt hunched demon with gray-green leathery skin, a swollen belly, long spindly arms ending in hooked claws, a bald misshapen head with a wide mouth of needle teeth and small white eyes. Its body constantly leaks a sickly yellow-green vapor that curls around it, and its edges fade into shadow as it slinks along a jagged rock toward the right, claws raised. Setting: a dim violet sky, steaming cracks in black rock, crooked spires. Two arms, two legs, one head; menacing, no gore.

MEDIUM (about waist height to a human). SOLO. A mastiff guards a noble's courtyard at night: a powerful heavy-boned dog with a short brindle coat, a broad wrinkled muzzle, drooping jowls and a spiked iron collar. It lunges forward toward the right at the end of its chain, teeth bared and barking, front paws braced on the flagstones. A wooden gate, a lantern on a post and a water barrel give scale. Setting: moonlit stone courtyard, ivy walls, warm lantern glow. Four legs, one head.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A modron pentadrone strides across a vast clockwork plain: a construct with a flat five-pointed star-shaped body of dull bronze, standing on FIVE thin jointed legs and with FIVE jointed arms radiating from the star's points, a smooth geometric face plate in the center. It discharges five thin bolts of lightning from its five hands into a gear pylon to the right, while a pale cone of paralysis gas hisses from vents in its center. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge holds a shield up. Setting: Mechanus, endless turning cogs, cold geometric light. SCALE CHECK: the pentadrone stands about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A mud mephit squelches out of a riverbank: a small, pot-bellied impish creature made of dripping brown and gray mud, with a lumpy head, sad sagging face, two small clumsy batlike wings dripping sludge, stubby arms and legs. It spits a thick gob of mud from its mouth toward the right that splatters over a lost boot on the bank, the boot giving scale beside a fishing rod and a reed basket. Setting: a drab marshy riverbank under gray drizzle, reeds and puddles. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head; grumpy and grotesque.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A performer legend commands a packed opera stage: a tall dark-skinned middle-aged tiefling man with curling ram horns, a flowing velvet coat in deep plum and gold, rings on every finger, conducting with a jewel-encrusted baton. He sings with arms raised, mouth open, and luminous rings of golden sound and shimmering musical light spiral out toward the right from his voice and baton, enchanting the air itself. Setting: footlights, red curtains, chandeliers, a blurred audience in the dark. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character.

MEDIUM (about deer-sized, wingspan ~4 m). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A peryton dives from a stormy sky over a mountain pass: a monster with the head and antlers of a great stag, the body, plumage and large wings of an enormous dark green-black eagle, two clawed eagle legs, and burning orange eyes. It swoops down toward the right with talons forward and antlers lowered, casting the SHADOW OF A MAN on the ground instead of its own. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge braces a spear on the rocky trail. Setting: gray storm light, ragged pines, a cliff edge. Two wings, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: its body is about as large as the adventurer, wings much wider.

LARGE (about 5 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A plesiosaurus rises beside a small fishing boat on a misty lake: a long-necked marine reptile with smooth gray-green skin, a small head with a mouth of needle-like teeth, a broad body with FOUR large paddle flippers and a short tail. Its neck rears high out of the water and its jaws snap at a leaping fish to the right of the boat, sending spray across the water. Two adventurers in the boat at the lower right, seen from behind, grip an oar and a harpoon. Setting: dawn fog, pine-covered shores. Four flippers, one head. SCALE CHECK: its raised head reaches about one and a half times the height of a standing adventurer above the water.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A priest acolyte in a village shrine at dawn: a young halfling woman with short curly auburn hair, a simple undyed robe over a leather jerkin, a wooden holy symbol of a sun disk on a cord, and a flanged mace on her belt. She lifts one hand and calls down a column of radiant flame onto a cracked shadowy idol on the right, her other hand raised in prayer, warm light washing over her face. Setting: modest stone shrine, candles, wildflower offerings, morning light. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long). SOLO. A reef shark glides over a coral reef: a sleek gray shark with a white underside, black-tipped fins, a pointed snout and cold black eyes. It turns sharply toward the right with jaws parted, two more sharks circling behind it in the turquoise water, a sunken anchor and a diver's lost dagger on the sand below as scale cues. Setting: shimmering sunlight shafts through clear water, colorful coral, small fleeing fish. One tail, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A sahuagin priestess conducts a rite in a sunken reef temple: a fish-like humanoid with deep green scales, a paler belly, a fanned spiny dorsal fin, black eyes, a shark-toothed mouth and webbed clawed hands and feet, wearing a mantle of kelp and shark teeth and a coral headdress. She thrusts a clawed hand forward and conjures a pair of ghostly translucent blue shark jaws that snap toward the right, while real sharks circle above her in the water. Setting: underwater ruins of coral pillars, cold blue-green light from above. Two arms, two legs, one tail fin.

TINY (palm-sized, about 10 cm). SOLO. A scorpion on a desert camp table at night: a glossy amber-yellow arachnid with EIGHT legs, two raised pincers and a segmented tail arched high over its back ending in a sharp stinger glistening with venom. It skitters across a spread map toward the right, tail poised to strike, beside a brass candle stub, a tin cup and a few copper coins as scale cues. Setting: candlelit tent interior, sand on the canvas. Eight legs, two pincers, one tail.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A shrieker in an Underdark fungus forest: a human-sized purple-and-gray mushroom with a thick fleshy stalk and a broad spotted cap, no eyes or mouth. Triggered by light, it emits a piercing shriek shown as visible rippling rings of sound pulsing out across the cave toward the right, disturbing clouds of spores and setting distant shapes stirring. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge flinches back, lowering a lantern. Setting: giant mushrooms, glowing spores, damp gloom. SCALE CHECK: the shrieker is about as tall as the adventurer.

LARGE (lion-bodied, about 3.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER for scale. A sphinx of lore guards a forgotten library-vault: the body of a powerful tawny lion, two great falcon-like wings of dark gold and brown feathers, and the head of a hawk-eyed noble woman with dark skin, a long braided headdress of lapis and gold, and wise, inscrutable eyes. Seated on a dais between towering shelves of scrolls, she raises her head and the air around her ripples as the years flow — hourglass sand and drifting dust swirl in a spiral to the right, aging a wooden bookcase into crumbling ruin. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge holds a torch. Setting: dim amber lamplight, dusty columns. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: seated, her head is about one and a half times the adventurer's height.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A spy on the rooftops of a nighttime city: a lean, nondescript dark-haired elf woman in close-fitting charcoal leathers, a hooded cloak and soft boots, a shortsword sheathed on her hip. She crouches on a ridge of slate shingles beside a chimney and aims a small hand crossbow toward the right, a stolen letter tucked in her belt, ready to leap to the next roof. Setting: moonlit rooftops, distant lit windows, a bell tower. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character.

LARGE (a swarm covering a large area). SOLO. A swarm of lemures oozes down the iron streets of the city of Dis: dozens of sluggish, sagging humanoid shapes of dull reddish-brown waxy flesh with lumpen blank heads and drooping arms, without visible legs, merged into one heaving mass that drips with vile slime. The mass flows forward toward the right like molten tallow between iron walls, a toppled iron brazier and a chained gate for scale. Setting: red-hot iron buildings, hellish orange glow, choking smoke. Eerie and pitiful, no gore.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering a large area). SOLO. A swarm of ravens bursts from a dead oak over a frozen battlefield at dusk: dozens of glossy black ravens with sharp beaks and beady eyes, wings spread in all directions, forming one swirling shrieking cloud that sweeps toward the right. A rusted helmet on a spear stuck in the snow and a broken wooden cart give scale. Setting: snow, gray-violet sky, a low red sun. Each bird has two wings and two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A troglodyte springs out of a crevice in a dank cavern: a squat reptilian humanoid with rough gray-brown scales that shift color to match the rock, a crest of spines along its head and back, a short tail, a lizardlike snout with bulging eyes, clawed hands and feet. It leaps from the wall toward the right, claws spread and mouth gaping, while a visible greenish stench haze surrounds it. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge raises a sword and covers their nose. Setting: dark cavern, stalagmites, a guttering torch. Two arms, two legs, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: the troglodyte is slightly shorter than the adventurer.

SMALL (a severed troll arm about 1 m long). SOLO. A severed troll arm crawls across the floor of a ruined guardroom: a long, rubbery mottled green arm with a ragged stump and three-jointed gnarled fingers ending in black claws, regrowing small knobby bones and sinew at its torn end. It drags itself forward on its fingertips toward the right, claws raised, past a dropped torch and an overturned stool that give scale. Setting: stone floor, scattered straw, flickering firelight. One arm and one hand only, no gore.

LARGE (horse-sized, about 2.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A warhorse skeleton gallops out of a misty ruined battlefield: the dry skeleton of a great warhorse with tarnished barding plates and a rotting saddle still strapped to its spine, a cold blue glow in its empty eye sockets. It rears up on its hind legs, front hooves striking at the air toward the right. A single adventurer seen from behind at the lower right edge raises a shield. Setting: foggy moor with broken banners and leaning spears. Four legs, one head, dry bones, no flesh. SCALE CHECK: rearing, it is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A warrior veteran holds a mountain pass: a broad-shouldered gray-haired half-orc woman with scars and a short-cropped braid, wearing worn plate-and-mail with a patched cloak. She stands braced on a rocky ridge with a greatsword raised in both hands, a heavy crossbow slung on her back, her face grim and focused as she turns toward an unseen enemy on the right. Setting: windy pass at dawn, snow-capped peaks, fluttering banner. Two arms, two legs, one head; an original character.

TINY (about 25 cm long). SOLO. A weasel in an old barn: a slender long-bodied creature with reddish-brown fur, a white belly, a small head with beady black eyes, small rounded ears, short legs and a long tail. It bares tiny sharp teeth as it darts out from a stack of grain sacks toward the right, past a spilled egg basket and a horseshoe that give scale. Setting: warm sunbeams through barn slats, straw dust. Four legs, one tail, one head.

LARGE (body ~6 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. Midday at a palm-fringed desert oasis: a young brass dragon lounges sprawled across a sun-baked sandstone ruin above the water, head lifted and turned toward two travelers at the lower right, mouth half open as if mid-sentence, one foreclaw raised in a lazy, demanding gesture while a curl of shimmering golden sleep vapor drifts from its nostrils into the air. Gleaming brass-gold scales, a broad wing-like crest plate on its head, two wings folded loosely, four clawed legs, a long tail coiled through the ruin. The adventurers, seen from behind, hold out a small offering chest, weapons sheathed but hands near the hilts. Setting: turquoise pool, heat haze, dunes beyond. SCALE CHECK: the dragon is only about one and a half times as tall as the adventurers, its body about three times as long. Four legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (body ~6 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A young silver dragon perches on the roof of a ruined mountain watchtower during a snowstorm: shining silver scales, a smooth crested head with a frill, two wings half spread, a long tail. It breathes a cone of glittering frost from its open mouth over the tower's empty battlements to the right, coating stone and timber in ice. Two adventurers seen from behind stand at the base of the tower at the lower right. Setting: blizzard, gray clouds. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurers, its body about three times as long.

MEDIUM (human-sized upper body, long serpent tail). SOLO. A yuan-ti malison of the third type rises from a sunken ziggurat pool: a human head and upper body with greenish-bronze scaled skin, slit-pupiled golden eyes and a hairless scaled scalp, wearing a jeweled collar and gold armbands, two human arms, and instead of legs a long thick coiled serpent body of banded green and black scales. Coiling around a stone column, it flings a sizzling burst of green poison from its hand toward the right, the venom splashing across a carved stone serpent head. Setting: a dim jungle temple interior, torches, dark water. Two arms, no legs, one head.

HUGE (body ~13 m long including tail). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult brass dragon bursts up out of a dune at dusk, sand pouring off its back: gleaming brass-gold scales, a broad flat head plate shaped like a wide ornate crest sweeping back from the brow, a long neck, two great wings half unfolded, four clawed legs and a long tail still buried in the sand. It exhales its Sleep Breath: a slow, drifting cone of shimmering rose-gold vapor rolling out from its open mouth to the right over an empty desert campsite with a cold fire pit and a striped canvas tent. Two adventurers in desert cloaks stand at the lower right edge, seen from behind, scarves pulled over their faces, weapons ready. Setting: rippling dunes, long violet shadows, first stars. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head is roughly as long as an adventurer is tall and its raised shoulder is about three times their height. Four legs, two wings, one head.

HUGE (body ~14 m long including tail). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult silver dragon breaks out of a sunlit cloud bank above a high mountain pass: shining silver scales with pale blue sheen, a smooth elegant head with a tall frill running from the back of the skull down the neck, a pointed chin, two broad wings spread wide, four legs with claws tucked and a long tapering tail. Banking toward the right, it unleashes its Paralyzing Breath, a cone of pale, glittering silver-white mist that rolls across the empty stone road ahead of a halted wagon. Two adventurers stand on the road at the lower right edge, seen from behind, one shielding her eyes, one gripping a halberd. Setting: snow-dusted pass, wind-torn clouds, bright cold daylight. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head is about as long as an adventurer is tall; its body is about three times their height when seen side by side. One head, two wings, four legs; majestic rather than evil.

SMALL (an ordinary broom, about 1.3 m long). SOLO. An animated broom whirls through the air of a cluttered wizard's tower study: a plain wooden besom broom with a straight ash-wood handle and a bound bundle of straw bristles, no face, no limbs, moving by itself. It swoops diagonally toward the right in a fast fly-by swing, bristles first, scattering loose parchment sheets (blank, no writing), spilled ink and a toppled candlestick. Setting: a round room with bookshelves, a wooden desk, a stool, a brass astrolabe and dusty sunbeams through a narrow window; the desk and stool give the scale. Mischievous menace, a little uncanny; one broom, one rigid continuous handle.

TINY (about 70 cm long, low to the ground). SOLO. A badger at the mouth of its sett on a woodland bank at dusk: a stocky, low-slung animal with coarse grizzled gray fur, a black-and-white striped face with small dark eyes and small ears, short powerful legs and long digging claws. It stands half out of the burrow, back fur bristling, teeth bared in a snarl toward the right, earth spraying from its front claws. Setting: roots of an old oak, fallen leaves, ferns and a dropped leather boot near the burrow giving the scale. Four legs, one short tail; fierce and territorial.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A bandit, a lean young half-orc woman with a shaved head, a scarred lip and a weather-beaten face, crouches on a rocky ledge above a narrow mountain road at morning, wearing a patched leather jerkin, a faded red neckerchief half pulled up and worn boots. She aims a loaded light crossbow held in both hands down toward the right, a curved scimitar hanging at her hip. Below, the empty road winds past a tied-up mule. Setting: scrub pines, gray rocks, drifting morning haze. Two arms, two legs; the crossbow is one continuous rigid object.

GARGANTUAN (a heaving mass about 15 m across). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A blob of annihilation rolls over the ruins of a toppled marble temple: a colossal glistening ooze of deep violet-black slime whose translucent depths open into the silver-black void of the Astral Sea, with tiny drifting stars and the petrified fragments of a broken god-statue floating inside. It surges forward toward the right, lashing two long dripping pseudopods high into the air, while columns crumble and dissolve into dust where its edge touches them. Two adventurers at the lower right foreground, seen from behind, stand on a fallen column, readying a glowing sword and a staff. Setting: storm-dark sky, scattered marble blocks. SCALE CHECK: a standing column is about four adventurers tall, and the blob's mass rises about three times higher than the column. No eyes, no face, no limbs other than the pseudopods.

MEDIUM (about 2.1 m tall, long-limbed). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A bugbear stalker hangs crouched on the thatched roof eave of a village house at night: a lean, hairy goblinoid with coarse dark-brown fur, a broad bearish face with a flat nose, small fangs, long pointed ears and glinting yellow eyes, wearing dark leathers and a hooded fur cloak, a bundle of javelins across its back and a spiked morningstar in one hand. Its other long arm stretches down silently toward the right, fingers spread, just above a lantern-carrying adventurer seen from behind in the alley at the lower right edge, who has not yet noticed it. Setting: moonlit timber houses, a well, deep shadows. SCALE CHECK: standing, the bugbear would be only a head taller than the adventurer. Two arms, two legs; the moment before the grab.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A cambion hovers above the battlements of a burning hill fort at dusk: a half-fiend with ash-red skin, two curving black horns, sharp elegant features, burning yellow eyes, black hair tied back, and two large leathery bat wings, wearing dark plate-and-leather armor with a short cape. It extends one clawed hand and fires a searing Fire Ray toward the right, the beam striking a wooden watchtower roof that bursts into flame. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind on the wall walk, raises a shield. Setting: smoke, sparks, a red-orange sky. SCALE CHECK: the cambion is the same height as the adventurer. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long including tail, a young dragon). SOLO. A copper dragon wyrmling clings head-down to a sunlit red-sandstone canyon wall: a young dragon with burnished copper scales just starting to show blue-green tinges at the edges, a smooth head with a pair of backswept horns and frilled cheek plates, bright curious eyes, two small wings and a long tail. It grins mischievously and spits a thin stream of hissing green acid toward the right onto a carved rock ledge, which smokes and pits. A traveler's dropped water skin and a juniper bush give the scale. Setting: layered canyon rock, blue midday sky. Four legs, two wings, one head; playful but dangerous.

TINY (about 25 cm across). SOLO. A crab on a tide-pool rock at golden evening light: a broad reddish-brown shell with orange mottling, two stalked black eyes, eight jointed walking legs and two raised claws, the larger claw snapping open toward the right. Seawater splashes over the rock. Scale cues: a scattered copper coin, a seashell and the edge of a rope coil beside it. Setting: barnacles, kelp, low surf, a distant ship silhouette. Eight legs plus two claws, exactly.

MEDIUM (a large dog, about 1 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A death dog lopes out of a dust storm in a desolate badland: a gaunt, mangy two-headed hound with patchy sand-brown hide stretched over ribs, TWO heads on two necks from one body, both with snarling jaws, yellowed fangs and burning amber eyes, four legs and a long thin tail. Both heads snap forward toward the right, slavering, toward an adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who levels a spear. Setting: cracked earth, bleached bones of a cow skull, swirling ochre dust. SCALE CHECK: the dog's back reaches the adventurer's hip. Exactly two heads, one body, four legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, armored). SOLO. A death knight aspirant rides out at the head of an undead column on a misty moor at dusk, mounted on a translucent spectral steed of pale blue-gray mist: a fallen knight in tarnished, dented plate armor still showing old faded enamel, a cracked open-faced helm revealing a gaunt, gray, half-withered face with sunken eyes glowing faint red. It points a long notched black sword toward the right, and a dark necrotic glow spreads from it, urging on a line of skeletons with spears marching through the fog behind. Setting: a broken stone cross on the hill, dead heather, low red sun. Two arms, two legs; the steed has four legs and one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized, squat and heavy). SOLO. A death slaad stalks across a chaotic shard of Limbo: a toad-like humanoid with charcoal-black, slick skin speckled with tiny pale glinting points like stars, a wide fanged frog mouth, cold bulging eyes, two muscular arms and two thick bent legs. It swings a long curved blade of shimmering, ever-shifting chaos energy, crackling between violet and green, high to the right, slicing through a floating boulder that splits apart. Setting: churning sky of mixed fire, water and drifting earth chunks, dim purple light. Two arms, two legs, one head; malevolent and cold.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A druid, a middle-aged wood elf man with dark brown skin, a braided gray-streaked beard and leaves woven into his hair, wearing layered moss-green and bark-brown robes with a hide mantle, stands in an ancient oak grove at dawn. He thrusts a gnarled wooden staff forward toward the right, thick thorny vines whipping out of the ground and coiling up a standing stone (no carvings), while a small glowing green wisp of light floats above his open left palm. Setting: mist, ferns, shafts of morning light, a stag in the distance. Two arms, two legs; the staff is one continuous rigid object.

GARGANTUAN (a towering storm-figure about 30 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An elemental cataclysm rises over a coastal plain like a living natural disaster: a vast vaguely humanoid upper body of churning rock and magma, its shoulders wrapped in a roaring hurricane, one arm a whirling column of seawater, the other a pillar of fire, its head a crackling storm-cloud core with two blazing white eyes, its lower body a swirling vortex of dust, lightning and spray. It brings both arms down toward the right, splitting the ground open in a line of erupting lava and steam across the empty fields. Two adventurers on a hill at the lower right edge, seen from behind, brace in the wind with cloaks streaming. SCALE CHECK: a farmhouse in the middle distance reaches barely to the elemental's ankles of whirling dust. Exactly two arms, one head.

HUGE (about 3.5 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An elephant bull charges across an acacia savanna in late afternoon: wrinkled gray hide dusted with red earth, enormous fanned ears flared wide, two long curved ivory tusks, the trunk raised high as it trumpets. It thunders forward toward the right, kicking up a cloud of red dust, scattering a flock of birds. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, stands beside a lone acacia tree with a spear grounded. SCALE CHECK: the adventurer's head reaches only to the elephant's knee joint; the elephant is about twice the adventurer's height at the shoulder. Four legs, one trunk, two tusks.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. An empyrean iota, a small fragment of a slain titan's celestial essence, hovers above a moonlit mountain shrine: a translucent luminous figure with a serene, ageless humanlike face, eyes of pure white light and flowing hair like slow-moving flame, its upper body two-armed and graceful, its lower body dissolving into a long trailing wisp of golden starlight instead of legs. It raises one glowing hand and sends a soft spiral of radiant golden motes toward the right onto a wilted tree, which bursts into new leaf. Setting: weathered stone steps, a small cairn, night sky with drifting clouds; the cairn and steps give the scale. Two arms, one head, ethereal and wondrous.

SMALL (about 60 cm long). SOLO. A giant fire beetle crawls over a mine-cart rail deep in an abandoned mine: a beetle with a glossy dark red-brown carapace, six jointed legs, two short antennae and serrated mandibles, and two round glands above its eyes and one on its abdomen glowing bright orange like embers, casting warm light across the tunnel. It rears its head toward the right, mandibles open. Scale cues: a dropped miner's pick, a tin lantern and timber props. Exactly six legs, two antennae, three glowing glands.

LARGE (arm span about 5 m). SOLO. A giant octopus surges up beside a sunken shipwreck in green-blue shallow water: a bulbous mottled reddish-brown mantle, two large golden eyes with horizontal pupils, and EXACTLY eight long muscular arms lined with pale suckers, spread wide as it releases a billowing black ink cloud that unfurls toward the right through the water. Some arms coil around the broken mast and a barnacled cannon. Setting: shafts of sunlight from the surface, sand, drifting seaweed, small fish scattering; the ship's railing and a treasure chest give the scale. Eight arms, no fins, no tentacles beyond the eight.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant wasp dives out of a huge papery nest hanging from a cliff overhang in summer heat: a black-and-yellow banded body, translucent amber wings blurred in motion, large black compound eyes, two antennae, six jointed legs and a long glistening stinger curled forward under its abdomen. It streaks toward the right in a fast flyby above an adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, ducking with a raised buckler. Setting: dry grass, wildflowers, other wasps circling the nest. SCALE CHECK: the wasp is about as long as the adventurer is tall. Four wings, six legs, one stinger.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A goristro smashes through the gate of a fortress courtyard: a hulking stooped demon like a monstrous minotaur, with dark brown hide, a massive bull head crowned by two enormous forward-curving horns, small red-glowing eyes, a ring of shaggy mane, two gigantic arms with heavy clawed hands and two thick hooved legs. Lowering its horns it charges toward the right, splintered gate timbers and stones flying from its shoulders. Two adventurers at the lower right foreground, seen from behind, brace with shield and polearm. Setting: dust, torchlight, broken walls. SCALE CHECK: the goristro is about three and a half times as tall as the adventurers. Two arms, two legs, one head, two horns.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A gray slaad, which has just dropped its human disguise, stands in a candle-lit library aisle: a toad-like humanoid with mottled ash-gray skin, a wide frog mouth with sharp teeth, bulging pale eyes, two muscular arms ending in long hooked claws crackling with faint dark energy and two thick bent legs. Torn scraps of a scholar's robe still hang from its shoulders. It springs toward the right, claws spread, toward an adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who draws a rapier. Setting: tall shelves of books (no legible writing), a toppled reading desk, scattered candles. SCALE CHECK: the slaad is about the same height as the adventurer. Two arms, two legs, one head.

GARGANTUAN (about 12 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A Gulthias blight tears itself free from a ruined hilltop in a dying forest: a colossal, twisted dead tree come to life, its black bark split by veins of dark crimson sap, a gaping knotted maw in the trunk, crooked branch-arms ending in clawlike twigs, and a mass of thick roots it walks on. It flings a volley of long sharp thorns from its branches toward the right, the thorns thudding into the ground and a fallen log, while pale pulsing roots crawl over the soil.
