Two adventurers at the lower right foreground, seen from behind, crouch behind a boulder with a bow and a sword. Setting: withered gray trees, red-tinted twilight. SCALE CHECK: the blight is about seven times the adventurers' height, like a full-grown oak.

MEDIUM (human-sized, broad-shouldered). SOLO. A hobgoblin warlord stands on the rampart of a timber-and-stone fortress at dawn, commanding: a goblinoid with dark orange-red skin, a stern face with a flat dark nose and sharp gold eyes, gray-streaked black hair in a high topknot, wearing ornate lacquered plate with a war cloak in deep crimson. One hand raises a gleaming longsword toward the right, signaling an advance; the other grips a javelin. Below and behind, ordered ranks of hobgoblin soldiers with plain banners (no symbols) march out through the gate. Setting: misty valley, warm sunrise, smoke from campfires. Two arms, two legs; disciplined, regal and menacing.

SMALL (about 45 cm at the shoulder). SOLO. A jackal pack at dusk in a dry riverbed: the lead jackal, a lean dog-like animal with golden-tan fur, a dark saddle on its back, large pointed ears, a narrow muzzle and a bushy black-tipped tail, stands on a rock snarling toward the right, while two more jackals circle behind it. Scale cues: a cracked clay jar, a traveler's dropped sandal and dry thorn bushes. Setting: pale dusk sky, long shadows. Each jackal has four legs and one tail.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A knight, a broad-shouldered dwarf woman with braided auburn hair and a stern weathered face, in polished plate armor with a blue tabard (no heraldry), stands guard on a rain-slick stone bridge before a castle gate. She plants her feet and raises a two-handed greatsword in a high guard, angled toward the right, ready to meet a charge. Setting: gray drizzle, lanterns flickering on the parapet, a war horse waiting behind her. Two arms, two legs; the greatsword is one continuous rigid object held firmly in both hands; resolute, honorable.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A kuo-toa whip, a priest of the fish-folk, leads a procession through a drowned Underdark grotto lit by pale blue phosphorescent fungi: a fish-like humanoid with slick silver-green scales, a large fish head with bulging round eyes, gills and a wide lipless mouth, two webbed hands, two webbed feet, wearing a ragged shell-and-bone vestment. It holds a long pincer staff ending in a clawed metal pincer in one hand and, with the other, conjures a slimy glowing green glob that hurls toward the right and splatters on a rock, sizzling. A faint shimmering aura of faith surrounds it. Behind it, other kuo-toa kneel before a lumpy driftwood idol. Two arms, two legs.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A magma mephit perches on a cooling lava flow inside a volcanic vent: a small impish elemental formed of dark cracked crust with glowing molten orange lava showing through the cracks, two small batlike wings, pointed ears, a sly fanged grin and bright yellow eyes, two thin arms and two short legs. It exhales a gout of fire toward the right that splashes against black basalt. Scale cues: an abandoned blacksmith's tongs and a small iron cauldron beside it. Setting: steam vents, embers, a red glow. Two arms, two legs, two wings.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A pack of manes crawls out of a crack in the ground on a blasted Abyssal plain: the foremost manes is a squat, pale gray-green demon with a bloated belly, a stunted body, a gaping toothy mouth, small empty glowing eyes, long thin arms ending in sharp claws and short bent legs. It shuffles toward the right with claws outstretched, a dozen more stumbling behind it. Scale cues: a broken cartwheel and a dropped human-sized iron helmet beside it. Setting: red-black smoky sky, sulfur vents. Two arms, two legs per manes; wretched rather than mighty.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A modron quadrone flies in formation over the gearwork plains of Mechanus: a cube-shaped bronze body with a flat expressionless face on its front side, two round eyes and a straight mouth, FOUR jointed metal arms and two short legs, and two small mechanical wings on its back. It aims a compact gears launcher held in two of its hands toward the right, firing a stream of spinning brass cogs at a cracked bronze target plate. Other modrons march in perfect lines below. Setting: colossal turning gears, coppery haze, precise geometric shapes. Four arms, two legs, two wings, one cube-shaped body; utterly orderly.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A stubborn mule on a narrow mountain trail: a sturdy animal with a dark brown coat, a pale muzzle, long upright ears, a short upright mane and a tufted tail, loaded with saddlebags, a coiled rope and a cooking pot. It kicks out its hind legs toward the right in a bad-tempered buck, rocks flying, while an adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, steps back holding a lead rope. Setting: pine slopes, a steep drop, afternoon sun. SCALE CHECK: the mule's back is at the adventurer's chest height. Four legs, one head.

LARGE (about 2.8 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An ogre zombie shambles out of a collapsed barrow mound at night: a massive dead ogre with mottled gray-green dry skin, a slack jaw with jutting tusks, empty dull white eyes, matted hair and torn hide wrappings. It lurches forward toward the right, one huge fist raised for a crushing slam, the other arm dragging. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, raises a torch and a warhammer. Setting: toppled standing stones, mist, cold moonlight. SCALE CHECK: the zombie is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer. Two arms, two legs; eerie and dry, no gore.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A performer maestro, a tall tiefling woman with dusky lavender skin, curled ram horns, a sweeping coat of deep teal velvet and lace cuffs, stands on the edge of a lamp-lit theater stage. Singing, she flourishes a slender rapier in one hand toward the right, while from her other raised hand a swirling wave of shimmering violet and gold notes and light spreads into the air over the empty seats. Setting: velvet curtains, footlights, a painted backdrop (no text). Two arms, two legs, one tail; the rapier is one continuous rigid blade.

LARGE (about 3 m tall standing). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A polar bear heaves itself out of dark arctic water onto an ice floe under a low winter sun: thick creamy-white fur streaming with water, a long neck, a black nose and small dark eyes, massive paws with black claws. It rears up on the floe edge with a roar toward the right, water sheeting off its fur. A single adventurer in furs at the lower right edge, seen from behind on the neighboring floe, stands ready with a harpoon. Setting: pack ice, pale pink sky, breath steam. SCALE CHECK: rearing, the bear is about one and three-quarter times the adventurer's height. Four legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A priest, an elderly halfling man with a kind lined face, shaved head and a short white beard, wearing layered white and saffron vestments with a plain sun-disc pendant, stands on the steps of a village chapel at sunset. He raises a flanged mace in one hand and holds the other palm high, from which a column of golden radiant flame descends toward the right onto the cobblestones, driving back a creeping shadow. Setting: open chapel doors with warm candlelight, a bell tower, kneeling villagers in the distance. Two arms, two legs; the mace is one continuous rigid object; steadfast and holy.

HUGE (about 5 m tall standing). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A primeval owlbear rears among moss-covered standing stones in a primordial misty gorge at dawn: a massive ancient owlbear with a bear body covered in shaggy dark brown fur and layered ragged gray-brown feathers grown thick with moss and lichen, an owl head with an enormous scarred hooked beak, huge round orange eyes and long feather tufts, and two forelimbs with long curved claws. It throws its head back and unleashes a deafening screech, rings of sound ripping through the mist and scattering leaves and birds toward the right. Two adventurers at the lower right foreground, seen from behind, cover their ears. SCALE CHECK: the owlbear is about three times as tall as the adventurers. Four limbs, one head.

LARGE (about 1.8 m at the shoulder, 4 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A rhinoceros charges across a dusty dry-season grassland: thick gray armored hide with deep folds, two horns on its snout (a long front horn and a shorter one behind), small eyes, tufted ears and a short tail. It thunders toward the right, head lowered, dust exploding from its hooves, as an adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, dives aside behind a termite mound. Setting: golden grass, thorn trees, a heat-hazy horizon. SCALE CHECK: the rhinoceros's back is level with the adventurer's shoulders. Four legs, two horns.

MEDIUM (about 3 m long). SOLO. A salamander fire snake, a young salamander, slithers across a molten forge in a ruined fire-giant smithy: a sinuous serpent with no arms or legs, glowing orange-red scales cracked with yellow heat, a ridge of small flickering flames running along its spine, a wedge-shaped head with burning yellow eyes and a forked tongue. It rears up and strikes toward the right, jaws wide, and the air around it ripples with heat, scorching a wooden tool rack. Scale cues: an enormous anvil and human-sized hammer. Setting: glowing coals, smoke, dim red light. No limbs, one head.

TINY (about 15 cm tall). SOLO. A seahorse in a sunlit coral reef: a curled pale orange and gold seahorse with a horse-like head and long snout, a small dorsal fin fluttering, bony ringed body plates and a prehensile tail. It dashes upward toward the right inside a trail of silvery bubbles, darting past a lost brass ring and a sea-worn coin resting on the coral, which give the scale. Setting: swaying seagrass, small fish, rippling light from above. One head, one tail; delicate but alert.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A shadow demon slides out of the darkness of a moonless forest ruin: a featureless, smoke-like shape of living shadow with a vaguely humanoid upper body, two long arms ending in long talons, ragged bat-like wings of wispy darkness and a lower body that trails away into dark mist instead of legs, two pale cold eyes glowing in the void of its head. It reaches its claws toward the right past the edge of a guttering campfire, toward an adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who raises a torch high. Setting: crumbled arches, dark trees, the small circle of firelight. SCALE CHECK: the demon is the same height as the adventurer. Two arms, two wings, no legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long including tail, a young dragon). SOLO. A silver dragon wyrmling perches on the snowy roof ridge of a mountain monastery bell tower at clear morning: a young dragon with bright silver scales, a smooth head with a small frill and pointed chin, keen blue eyes, two small wings spread for balance and a long tail curled around a bell beam. It breathes a cone of glittering frost toward the right, coating icicles across the eaves. A bronze bell, roof tiles and a prayer flag line (no symbols) give the scale. Setting: snowy peaks, blue sky. Four legs, two wings, one head; noble and protective.

LARGE (lion-bodied, about 3 m long). SOLO. A sphinx of secrets lies on a dais in a lamp-lit underground archive: the powerful body of a lion with sand-gold fur, two large feathered wings in deep blue and gold folded along its back, and a serene humanlike head with an inscrutable smooth face, kohl-dark eyes glowing faint violet and a draped head cloth. It raises one forepaw and lifts its head as a pale violet riddle-light spirals from its gaze toward the right, wrapping around a floating scroll that unrolls in the air (no visible writing). Setting: shelves of scroll cases, a sealed stone door, braziers; four legs, two wings, one head.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering a large area). SOLO. A swarm of venomous snakes pours down the steps of a jungle ruin: dozens of thin vipers with banded green, black and yellow scales and arrow-shaped heads tangle and writhe over each other in a hissing mass, many rearing up with fangs bared and tongues flicking toward the right. Scale cues: a toppled clay urn, a dropped machete and a traveler's hat on the steps. Setting: vines, humid green light, stone blocks. Each snake has one head and no limbs.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. A tough boss, a heavyset orc man with a shaved head, a broken nose and a thick graying beard, wearing a studded leather coat over chain mail, stands in the middle of a dim dockside warehouse. He swings a heavy warhammer up onto his shoulder with one hand and points the other toward the right, ordering his crew of thugs forward from behind stacked crates and barrels. Setting: lantern light, ropes, harbor fog drifting through the open door. Two arms, two legs; the warhammer is one continuous rigid object.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A tree blight lurches out of a bog at the edge of a gloomy forest: a walking dead tree of gray-black twisted bark with a gaping jagged maw in the trunk, empty dark hollows like eyes above it, long whiplike branch-arms and a tangle of grasping roots as legs. One thick root snakes along the ground toward the right, reaching for the boot of an adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, who raises an axe. Setting: fog, dead reeds, crows on branches. SCALE CHECK: the blight is about three and a half times as tall as the adventurer. The moment before the root reaches.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. An ultroloth stands on a jagged volcanic outcrop on the bleak plane of Gehenna: a tall slender gray-skinned humanoid with a smooth featureless face except for two large almond-shaped eyes that swirl with hypnotic, shifting colors, wearing fine flowing robes of deep charcoal and dark purple. In one hand it cracks a long whip of liquid quicksilver that ripples through the air toward the right; it fixes its swirling gaze in the same direction, rings of colored light spiraling outward. Setting: ash-gray slopes, red molten fissures, smoky sky. Two arms, two legs, one head; no mouth, no nose.

MEDIUM (human-sized, heavyset). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A wereboar in hybrid form bursts from a thicket on a muddy woodland path at twilight: a hulking humanoid with bristly dark brown hair, a boar's head with a long snout, small red eyes and two big curving tusks, a barrel chest, two muscular arms and two hoofed legs, wearing torn leather breeches and a belt. It charges toward the right, head lowered, a javelin held in one hand, toward an adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who readies a boar spear. Setting: oak trees, mud and roots. SCALE CHECK: the wereboar is about as tall as the adventurer but twice as broad. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 80 cm at the shoulder). SOLO. A wolf pack hunts through a birch forest in early autumn: the lead wolf, a lean gray wolf with tawny flanks, pale amber eyes and a bushy tail, lunges forward toward the right with ears flat and teeth bared, while two more wolves flank it through the white trunks. Fallen golden leaves scatter. Scale cues: a hunter's abandoned bow and a wooden fence post. Setting: misty morning light. Each wolf has four legs and one tail.

LARGE (body about 6 m long including tail, about 2.5 m tall at the head). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young bronze dragon surges up from turquoise shallows beside a sunlit coral reef at midday: gleaming bronze scales, a ridged frill spreading behind its jaw, two backswept horns, two wings spread with water streaming off them, four webbed claws and a long tail. It exhales its Repulsion Breath, a rippling cone of force that blasts the sea spray and a small rowboat's empty oars back toward the right in a wall of water. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind on a rock, braces against the wind. SCALE CHECK: with its head raised, the dragon is about one and a half times the adventurer's height. Four legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (body about 6 m long including tail, about 2.5 m tall at the head). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. Bright overcast midday on a drifting ice floe in a gray polar sea: a young white dragon swoops down out of a snow squall, wings half folded for the dive, talons outstretched toward a seal-hunting camp of hide tents and kayaks at the right. Frost-white scales with pale blue tinges, a narrow head with a crested ridge and short swept-back horns, cold glittering eyes, two wings, four clawed legs, a long tail whipping behind. A plume of freezing mist trails from its open jaws into the air. One adventurer in furs at the lower right, seen from behind, plants a harpoon in the snow and braces. SCALE CHECK: the dragon is only about one and a half times the adventurer’s height. Four legs, two wings, one head; feral and savage.

MEDIUM (human-sized, about 1.5 m tall, wingspan about 6 m). SOLO. An aarakocra aeromancer hovers above a windswept mountain summit: a bird-person with a sharp hooked yellow beak, keen black eyes, sleek blue-gray and white plumage, two broad feathered wings spread wide, two feathered arms with taloned hands and two strong taloned bird legs, wearing a simple woven sash with feather tokens. It grips a long carved wooden staff firmly in both hands and swings it toward the right, unleashing a crackling gust of wind laced with a white-blue lightning arc that tears across the empty sky and whips the clouds. Setting: jagged peaks above a sea of clouds, bright high-altitude morning light. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head.

HUGE (body about 12 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER for scale. An adult bronze dragon surges out of the sea beside a wrecked merchant ship in a calm golden dawn: gleaming bronze scales with a green-blue patina at the edges, a ridged fin-like frill running down its neck, swept-back horns, webbed claws, two great wings half spread and dripping, a long tail churning the water. It exhales its Repulsion Breath, a rippling cone of shimmering pale-gold force that hurls a towering wall of seawater and broken planks away toward the right. On a rocky reef at the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind braces a shield, untouched. Setting: shallow turquoise lagoon, sea mist, morning sun low on the horizon. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head is about as long as the adventurer is tall, its body about seven times the adventurer's height.

HUGE (body about 12 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult white dragon bursts up through the frozen surface of a mountain lake at night: icy white scales with pale blue tinges, a crested head with a jagged frill and short backswept horns, a feral bestial snout, two broad leathery wings flung wide, a long tail, shards of thick lake ice exploding around it. It unleashes Freezing Burst, a ring of glittering frost that radiates out over the ice and freezes the air into crystals. Two adventurers seen from behind stand their ground on the shore ice at the lower right, weapons ready. Setting: snowy pines, green aurora overhead, cold blue moonlight. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head alone is about the size of a person, its body about seven times as long as an adventurer is tall.

SMALL (an ordinary longsword, about 1 m long). SOLO. An animated flying sword hovers in a dusty abandoned castle armory: a single plain steel longsword with a worn leather-wrapped grip and a simple crossguard, no hand holding it, glowing faintly with a pale blue arcane shimmer along the blade. It whirls and darts toward the right in a sweeping slash, a curved trail of blue light and stirred dust following its arc, as it guards an empty weapon rack. Clear scale cues: a wooden door, an empty armor stand, a fallen helmet and a lit wall torch. Setting: shafts of late-afternoon light through a narrow window, cobwebs. One sword, no wielder.

TINY (fist-sized body, wingspan about 30 cm). SOLO. A close-up of a bat swooping out of a cave mouth at dusk: brown-black fur, a pug-like face with large ears and tiny sharp teeth bared, two thin leathery wings spread wide with visible finger bones. It dives toward the right past a hanging lantern, while dozens of other bats stream out of the cave behind it as a dark ribbon. Clear scale cues: the lantern, a coil of rope and moss-covered stones at the cave edge. Setting: violet dusk sky, warm lantern glow. Two wings, two small hind legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized, tall and heavily built). SOLO. A berserker commander, a battle-scarred half-orc warrior woman with braided black hair, gray-green skin, a bear-pelt cloak with the bear's head as a hood and leather and iron armor, leads a frenzied rush down a grassy hillside at a misty dawn. She holds a heavy greataxe high in both hands, mouth open in a war cry, while a war band of fur-clad warriors charges behind her through the mist. Setting: rolling moorland, standing stones, low orange sunrise. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, hunched). SOLO. A bullywug bog sage, a frog-headed humanoid with mottled moss-green and brown warty skin, a wide frog mouth, large golden bulging eyes, webbed hands and feet and a wide throat sac, wears a crown of reeds, a cloak of woven swamp grass and strings of shells and bones. Crouching on a rotting log in a swamp, it holds a gnarled staff wrapped with lily pads and moss and casts a sickly green ray toward the right over the water, while a chorus of frogs and toads croaks around it. Setting: misty mangrove marsh, will-o'-wisp-like glowing insects, humid green twilight. Two arms, two legs, one head.

TINY (house-cat-sized). SOLO. A close-up of a lean tabby cat with striped gray-brown fur, green eyes and its ears flattened, pouncing from the top of a stack of old books in a candle-lit apothecary toward the right, claws out, at a mouse darting between glass bottles. Clear scale cues: a burning candle, glass jars of herbs, a mortar and pestle and a human hand resting at the right edge of the shelf. Warm candlelight, dust motes. Four legs, one tail; no readable text on books or labels.

LARGE (about 2.5 m long). SOLO. A chasme hovers in a ruined chapel on a foggy night: a monstrous demon shaped like a giant housefly with a humanoid-like gaunt face, huge multifaceted red compound eyes and a long sharp proboscis, a bristly black-blue segmented body covered in coarse hairs, two buzzing translucent insect wings, and six thin jointed legs ending in hooked feet. It lifts off from a crumbling wall toward the right, its wings vibrating in a blur that sends a visible ripple of droning sound through the air and flickering candle flames. Setting: broken stained windows without imagery, green-gray fog, cold moonlight. Six legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (about 4 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER for scale. A crocodile lies half-submerged in a still, muddy jungle river, only its knobbly eyes and nostrils above the water, then explodes upward toward the right with jaws gaping wide, rows of jagged teeth bared, at an empty wooden canoe tied to a dock. A single adventurer seen from behind stands on the dock at the lower right edge, hand on a sword hilt, stepping back. Setting: hanging vines, lily pads, hot hazy afternoon light. Four short legs, one long tail. SCALE CHECK: the crocodile is about two and a half times as long as the adventurer is tall.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. An elemental cultist, a dark-skinned middle-aged man with a shaved head and ash-gray tattoos, wears layered robes of rust, ochre and slate blue with a hammered bronze gorget, standing in a ruined open-air temple carved into a desert cliff. He swings a heavy chain flail in one hand while his other hand reaches out toward the right, conjuring a churning claw of mixed fire, crackling lightning, frost and swirling acid that rakes across the stone floor. Setting: wind-blown sand, wavering heat, dramatic late-afternoon light. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 2.5 m long, antlers well above a person's head). SOLO. A great bull elk with dark brown mane, tan body and a huge spreading rack of antlers charges across a misty autumn meadow at dawn, head lowered and antlers aimed forward toward the right, hooves throwing up wet earth, breath steaming. Scale cues: a split-rail fence and young birch trees beside it. Setting: golden autumn forest edge, low sunlight through mist. Four legs, one head, two antlers.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An empyrean, a radiant titan child of the gods, stands on a mountaintop sanctuary: a perfectly proportioned giant humanoid with luminous bronze skin, flowing golden hair and burning golden eyes, wearing a simple celestial chiton and an ornate gilded breastplate. It raises a colossal golden maul high in both hands and brings it down onto the mountain rock, sending a shockwave of brilliant golden light rippling outward across the ground. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right kneel and brace on the stone. Setting: clouds below the summit, beams of sunlight. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the empyrean is about three and a half times as tall as an adventurer.

TINY (about 25 cm long, squirrel-sized). SOLO. A faerie dragon youth with glossy warm red-orange scales grading to yellow at the belly, a slim snout, curious large eyes and two delicate translucent butterfly wings, darts between apple blossoms in a sunny orchard at midday. It giggles as it breathes a puff of sparkling pink euphoria gas toward the right onto a startled bumblebee, its tail fading into transparent invisibility. Clear scale cues: apple blossoms, a single apple and a dropped pie on a picnic cloth below. Bright spring light. Four legs, two wings, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A flaming skeleton, a scorched human skeleton with blackened bones wreathed in bright orange flames that lick from its eye sockets, ribs and joints, the tatters of a burnt robe hanging from it, strides through a burnt-out library. It holds a charred iron scepter topped with fire in one bony hand and hurls a ball of flame from the other toward the right against a stone pillar, lighting the smoky room. Setting: smoldering shelves, falling ash, deep orange glow against darkness. Two arms, two legs, one skull; no readable text.

SMALL (a jellyfish-shaped body about 1 m across). SOLO. MEDIUM (about 1.5 m long, the size of a large dog). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant frog with mottled olive-green and brown warty skin, bulging golden eyes and a wide gaping mouth crouches on a rotten wooden jetty in a swamp at night and shoots its long pink sticky tongue toward the right at a hanging lantern, which swings away. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, stands in a flat-bottomed boat gripping a punt pole. Setting: cypress trees with hanging moss, fireflies, dark water reflecting lantern light. Four legs, one head, one tongue. SCALE CHECK: the frog's body is about as long as the adventurer is tall from waist to head.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). SOLO. A giant seahorse with an armored ridged body of orange and coral-pink plates, a long tubular snout, a crown-like frilled crest, a fluttering translucent dorsal fin and a curled prehensile tail, surges forward underwater toward the right in a burst of trailing bubbles, ramming through a school of silver fish. Setting: a sunlit coral reef with sea fans, kelp and a half-buried barnacled anchor for scale, light rays from the surface above. No legs, one tail, one fin.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A githyanki dracomancer, a gaunt humanoid with leathery yellow skin, a narrow face, sunken dark eyes, long pointed ears and a high topknot of black hair, wearing ornate crimson-and-black scaled armor with flowing dark robes, levitates above the jagged spine of a drifting astral island. With both hands thrust forward it conjures a huge translucent spectral dragon head of red-gold flame that roars a cone of fire and shimmering force energy toward the right into the empty silver void. Setting: the silvery Astral Sea with drifting rocks and a distant petrified god-husk. Two arms, two legs, one head; the dragon head is only magical light.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long with tail). SOLO. A gold dragon wyrmling with gleaming golden scales, a long whiskered snout with fine barbels, two smooth swept-back horns, small sail-like frilled wings and a slender tail stands proudly on a moss-covered fallen pillar in an overgrown ruined shrine garden in the morning, wings spread, and exhales a small bright cone of golden fire toward the right onto the stone flagstones. Setting: blooming wild roses, ivy-covered ruins, a stone birdbath and dewy grass giving scale, soft warm morning light. Four legs, two wings, one head. Majestic, not cute.

LARGE (about 4 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A grick ancient, a huge worm-like creature with a thick rubbery stone-gray body ridged like rock, its head a large hooked black beak ringed by EXACTLY four long segmented tentacles, coils around a massive stalactite and drops headfirst toward a rope bridge spanning an Underdark chasm, tentacles splayed wide. A single adventurer at the lower right edge on the bridge, seen from behind, holds up a lantern and braces a shield. Setting: deep cavern, mist rising from the chasm, glowing mineral veins. No legs, one beak, four tentacles. SCALE CHECK: the grick's body is about two and a half times as long as the adventurer is tall.

TINY (about 30 cm long, wingspan about 1 m). SOLO. A red-tailed hawk with brown back feathers, a pale streaked chest, a rust-red tail and a hooked yellow beak plunges in a steep dive toward the right, talons thrust forward, over a summer meadow toward a fleeing field mouse among the grass. Setting: bright afternoon sky, wildflowers, a weathered wooden fence post nearby for scale. Two wings, two legs, one head.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. An ice mephit, an impish elemental with a body of jagged translucent blue-white ice, spiky icicle horns, small bat-like crystalline wings and sharp frozen claws, hovers over a frozen mountain pond and exhales a cone of glittering frost toward the right, instantly freezing a small waterfall into icicles. Setting: a snowy pine slope at blue dusk, a half-buried wooden sled and a lantern for scale. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head, cruel smirk.

SMALL (about 1.2 m tall in hybrid form). SOLO. A jackalwere in hybrid form, a lean humanoid with the head of a jackal with large pointed ears, tawny and black fur, glowing amber eyes and a narrow fanged muzzle, wearing a ragged desert wrap, crouches atop a crumbling sandstone wall at night and fixes a hypnotic gaze toward the right, its eyes sending out a faint drifting golden haze of sleep magic toward an abandoned campsite of bedrolls and a dying campfire. Two ordinary jackals slink beside it. Setting: desert ruins under a full moon. Two arms, two legs, one head.

HUGE (about 8 m long). SOLO. A killer whale with sharp black-and-white markings, a white eye patch and a tall black dorsal fin breaches explosively from cold gray water beside a drifting ice floe at dawn, jaws open, lunging toward the right where two startled seals scramble across the ice. Setting: arctic sea, floating ice and distant snowy coast, spray glittering in pale light; a small wooden fishing boat in the far distance for scale. Two pectoral fins, one dorsal fin, one tail fluke.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A mage, an original lean person of mixed heritage with short dark hair, wearing travel-worn slate-gray and teal robes with a leather satchel, steps out of a dissolving cloud of silvery mist on a rain-slick stone bridge at night and flings a crackling sphere of violet arcane force from an outstretched hand toward the right; a translucent shimmering ward flickers around their body. Setting: a rain-soaked city of rooftops and chimneys with distant lit windows (no signs), the river below. Two arms, two legs; focused expression.

LARGE (about 3.5 m tall). SOLO. A marid, a regal water genie with deep blue-green skin with a pearly sheen, finned ears, a long dark beard braided with pearls, wearing a coral-studded breastplate and flowing sea-green silks, two muscular arms, its lower body a churning tail of seawater instead of legs, rises out of a stormy ocean beside a lone sea stack at sunset. It thrusts one hand forward, unleashing a powerful straight jet of water toward the right that blasts spray off a rock. Setting: towering waves, sunset light through spray and a wrecked ship's mast for scale. Two arms, one head, water below the waist.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A myconid spore servant, the reanimated body of a dwarf in rotted leather armor now overgrown with pale fungus: gray-white mushroom caps sprout from its shoulders and head, fungal threads cover its face and empty eyes, and puffballs cling to its arms. It shambles forward toward the right with heavy arms raised to slam through a bioluminescent Underdark cavern. Setting: giant glowing blue and violet mushrooms, drifting spores, a dropped pickaxe for scale. Two arms, two legs, one head; dry, no gore.

LARGE (about 3.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A nalfeshnee, a hulking corpulent demon with the body of a massive ape, the head of a boar with large curved tusks and small burning eyes, cloven hooves and a pair of absurdly small feathered wings on its back, sits on a crude throne of black rock and rises from it as a nimbus of sickly crimson horror light pulses outward from its body. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, braces with a shield raised against the glare. Setting: a hellish Abyssal court with obsidian pillars and fuming pits. Two arms, two legs, one head, two small wings. SCALE CHECK: the demon is about twice as tall as the adventurer.

TINY (about 30 cm tall). SOLO. A barn owl with a pale heart-shaped face, dark eyes and golden-buff wings spread wide glides silently out of the open loft of an old barn at night, talons extended, swooping low toward the right over a hay bale toward a mouse. Setting: moonlit farmyard, a wooden ladder, a pitchfork and a lantern for scale. Two wings, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 1.5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A piercer, a stalactite-shaped creature with a thick conical shell of gray-brown stone-like hide hanging from a cave ceiling, its pointed tip down and near its base a single large eye above a wide toothy mouth (ONE eye only, no ring of eyes), releases its grip and plunges point-first, falling to the floor just behind a single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, who walks on with a lantern, unaware. Setting: a cavern with many real stalactites, dripping water and lantern light. No legs. SCALE CHECK: the piercer is about as long as the adventurer is tall.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A pirate admiral, an original weathered captain of mixed heritage with a braided beard or braids, a scarred jaw and a confident grin, wearing a long sea-blue coat with tarnished gold trim, a tricorn hat and a red sash, stands on the quarterdeck of a heeling ship in a storm, scimitar raised high in one hand to rally the crew, while the other hand fires a flintlock pistol into the sky toward the right in a burst of smoke and flame. Setting: billowing sails, rigging, spray over the rail, lightning on the horizon. Two arms, two legs, each weapon one rigid object.

TINY (about 30 cm tall, the size of a hand). SOLO. A pixie wonderbringer, a tiny fey with long silver-white hair, iridescent dragonfly wings and a gown of woven moonflower petals, sits cross-legged on the stone railing of an old mossy bridge in the Feywild at night and flings both arms out toward the right, releasing a spiraling burst of rainbow light from which flowering vines and tiny luminous blossoms sprout out of the stones. Setting: glowing violet twilight, giant moon, fireflies, a dropped acorn cap and a snail on the stone for scale. Two arms, two legs, four wings.

MEDIUM (wingspan about 5 m, body about human torso size). SOLO. A pteranodon, a flying reptile with leathery tan-and-gray skin wings stretched between long fingers and legs, a long toothless pointed beak and a long backswept bony head crest, skims low over a stormy sea beside towering cliffs and snaps its beak toward the right at a leaping fish, wingtips almost touching the waves. Setting: overcast sky, crashing surf, a small fishing skiff near the cliff for scale. Two wings, two legs, one head, no feathers.

MEDIUM (about 2 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A quaggoth, a muscular humanoid with shaggy dirty-white fur, a broad bestial ape-like face with a blunt snout, small eyes and fanged jaws, and long powerful arms ending in black claws, leaps down from a rock ledge in an Underdark cavern with both claws raised, howling in fury, toward a single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, who raises a lantern and an axe. Setting: dark cavern with stalagmites and a narrow underground stream, phosphorescent fungi. Two arms, two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the quaggoth is only slightly taller than the adventurer.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A scarecrow construct with a straw-stuffed body in a tattered patched coat and floppy hat, a stitched burlap sack head with a ragged grin and two glowing orange eyes, and long sharp claws made of rusted iron nails and sickle blades on its straw hands, jerks free from its wooden post and lunges toward the right through a withered cornfield, eyes flaring. Setting: a harvest moon night, crows scattering, a farmhouse in the distance and corn stalks giving scale. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A scout captain, an original lean person of mixed heritage with weathered skin and short braided hair, wearing a hooded forest-green cloak over studded leather and a shortsword at the hip, crouches high on a thick branch of an old pine overlooking a mountain pass and draws a longbow to the cheek, aiming steadily toward the right, eyes narrowed. Setting: early morning fog in the valley below, distant cliffs, a hawk circling. Two arms, two legs; the bow is one rigid curved stave with a straight arrow.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A smoke mephit, an impish elemental made of swirling charcoal-gray smoke with a vaguely solid sooty body, glowing ember-red eyes, small wispy wings and clawed hands, perches on the edge of a blackened forge chimney and spits a sputtering cloud of glowing cinders and ash toward the right. Setting: a ruined blacksmith's workshop at night with a cold anvil, scattered horseshoes and tongs for scale, thick smoky haze. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head, mischievous grin.

LARGE (serpent body about 4.5 m long). SOLO. A spirit naga, a long serpent with glossy black scales banded in dull crimson, a human-like face with sharp malevolent features, a mane of dark hair and glowing red eyes, rears up from coils piled on a heap of old coins and broken idols in a moonlit desert ruin, and fires a crackling ray of black-violet necrotic energy from its open mouth toward the right, striking a sandstone column. Setting: drifting sand, toppled statues (no inscriptions) and a broken stone doorway for scale. No arms, no legs.

LARGE (a swarm filling an area about 3 m across). SOLO. A swarm of dozens of small brown and black bats with leathery wings and tiny fanged mouths pours out of a cave mouth at dusk, swirling into a dense spiraling cloud that streams toward the right. Setting: a rocky hillside, purple-orange sunset sky, a dead tree and a wooden mine-entrance frame for scale. Each bat has two wings and one head.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering about 1.5 m of floor). SOLO. A swarm of dozens of severed withered gray-brown undead hands, each scuttling on its fingertips like a spider, spills out of an overturned wooden crate and flows across a necromancer's laboratory floor toward the right, climbing over each other in a writhing tide and up a table leg. Setting: a dim cellar with alchemical glassware, scattered candles and a dropped quill for scale. Dry gray skin, no blood; each hand has five digits.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A vampire familiar, an original pale mortal servant of mixed heritage with dark-circled eyes and a fanatic smile, wearing an elegant but worn dark-burgundy livery coat, clings to the wall of a moonlit manor hallway near the ceiling and throws a dagger toward the right; the blade trails wisps of black shadow. Setting: a long gallery with tall arched windows, portraits with blank faces and candelabras for scale. Two arms, two legs; dagger one rigid object.

TINY (about 1 m long, slender). SOLO. A venomous viper with diamond-patterned brown and ochre scales, a triangular head and vertical-slit eyes coils on a sun-warmed rock beside a forest path and rears back, mouth wide open showing long fangs, ready to strike toward the right. Setting: dry forest floor with leaves, a leather boot and a dropped waterskin at the right edge for scale. No legs.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A violet fungus necrohulk, a hulking humanoid-shaped mass of fused violet and pale-lilac fungal stalks wrapped around old bones and armor scraps, with long tendril-like arms of mottled purple stalks and glowing violet spore sacs on its back, lumbers forward and hurls a bulging spore pod toward the right that bursts into a cloud of violet spores against a cave wall. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, pulls a scarf over the face and raises a torch. Setting: a damp cavern full of violet fungi and puddles. Two arms, two legs. SCALE CHECK: the necrohulk is about one and a half times as tall as the adventurer.

SMALL (about 0.9 m tall, wingspan about 1.5 m). SOLO. A winged kobold, a small reptilian humanoid with rust-red scales, a dog-like snout, two small backward horns, a thin tail and leathery bat-like wings growing from its back, dives from a cliff ledge at dusk over a canyon, clutching a jagged blade made from a dragon's tooth, and spits a glob of shimmering multicolored acid toward the right. Setting: a high canyon with nesting holes, a rope-and-plank bridge and a water barrel for scale. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (about 6 m long including tail). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young gold dragon with gleaming golden scales, a long whiskered snout with barbels, two backswept horns and large sail-like wings lands on the ruined marble steps of a cliffside monastery under a dramatic storm-lit sky and breathes a cone of golden fire toward the right over an empty stone causeway, barring the way. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, kneels with a lowered sword in respect. Setting: rain mist, distant waterfalls, crumbling columns. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon is about three times as long as the adventurer is tall.

LARGE (about 5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young remorhaz, a centipede-like creature with many short legs, a segmented armored body of icy blue-white plates, a broad head with large mandibles and a back ridge of plates glowing orange-red with heat, bursts up through the surface of a frozen lake, melting a circle of steaming water around itself. A single adventurer at the lower right edge, seen from behind, stands on the ice holding a spear near a small ice-fishing tent. Setting: a snowy pine shoreline under a pale winter sky, mist rising. SCALE CHECK: the body is about three times as long as the adventurer is tall.

HUGE (body ~12 m long). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. An adult gold dragon with gleaming burnished-gold scales, a long sinuous neck, a wise face framed by catfish-like whisker barbels and a crown of swept-back horns, and two broad sail-like wings whose membranes run along its body, rises out of a still forest lake at dawn, water streaming off its flanks. It exhales its Weakening Breath, a shimmering cone of pale golden mist, across the water toward an empty shore on the right, while a soft guiding light glows above its head. Two adventurers seen from behind stand on a mossy stone jetty at the lower right, weapons lowered in awe. Setting: misty lake, birch trees, sunrise haze. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: the dragon's head is about as long as an adventurer is tall, and its raised body is about three times their height.

MEDIUM (a large ape, about 1.7 m upright). SOLO. A powerful great ape with shaggy dark brown-black fur, a heavy brow, a broad bare gray face and long muscular arms, stands upright on a fallen mossy jungle trunk, chest thrust out, mouth open in a booming display roar, one huge hand raised high and gripping a fist-sized rock ready to hurl toward the right. Setting: humid jungle undergrowth in green-gold afternoon light with hanging vines, broad leaves and a cracked old stone idol for scale. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. An archpriest, an elderly dark-skinned woman with close-cropped silver hair, in layered white and ochre vestments with a heavy gold-embroidered stole and a simple sun-disc pendant, stands on the steps of a high cathedral altar and speaks a Holy Word: she raises an open hand and a ring of blinding radiant light bursts outward from her in all directions, rippling across the stone floor and blowing the candle flames sideways toward the right. Her face is calm and stern. Setting: a vaulted temple nave with tall pillars, incense smoke and shafts of light through high windows. Original person, not resembling any known character. Two arms, two legs.

SMALL (knee-high, about 1 m). SOLO. An awakened shrub, a scraggly bush of tangled brown twigs and sparse green leaves with a few red berries, pulls its gnarled root-feet out of the soil and shuffles forward across a garden path, two branch-arms raised and raking toward the right with thorny twig-claws; a knothole and two darker hollows in its foliage suggest a face. Setting: an overgrown wizard's herb garden at dusk, with a weathered stone bench, a clay watering can and a fallen gardening glove beside it for scale; soft lantern light from a cottage window.

LARGE (about 2.5 m tall, a flightless bird). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An axe beak, a tall flightless bird with long powerful legs ending in three-toed clawed feet, a thick body of coarse brown-and-ochre feathers, stubby useless wings and a huge wedge-shaped axe-like beak, sprints across open grassland and rears its head back to chop downward, beak gaping, kicking up dust. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind sidesteps with a quarterstaff raised. Setting: windy steppe at golden afternoon with tall dry grass and a distant wagon track. Two legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: the axe beak's head is only about one and a half times as high as the adventurer.

MEDIUM (dwarf-sized, about 1.4 m tall). SOLO. An azer pyromancer, a stocky dwarflike being with bronze metallic skin glowing with inner heat, a beard and hair of living orange flame, wearing a brass-scaled robe over a bronze kilt with a belt of brass tools, stands on a basalt bridge over a lava river and hurls a swirling sphere of fire from both hands toward the right, where it is about to burst against a black rock spire; a ring of fire aura flickers around his feet and lights the scene. Setting: the Plane of Fire with molten falls, ash sky and a distant brass city. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized, about 2 m). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A barbed devil, a tall lean fiend with dark red-brown hide covered all over in sharp hooked spines and barbs, long clawed hands, a barbed tail and glowing amber eyes in a spiky head, clings to a black rock wall in a hellish canyon and hurls a ball of hellfire conjured in its claw toward the right, at the rocks beside a single adventurer at the lower right edge seen from behind, who ducks behind a shield. Setting: the first layer of the Nine Hells with red sky, smoke and iron chains hanging from the cliffs. Two arms, two legs, one tail.

SMALL (hawk-sized, wingspan about 1 m). SOLO. A close-up of a blood hawk, a fierce bird of prey with crimson and rust-red plumage, dark-barred wing tips, a hooked black beak with a serrated edge and glaring yellow eyes, swooping out of a pale sky with talons forward and wings fully spread, toward the right. Two more blood hawks circle behind it. Setting: a windswept rocky coastal cliff with sea spray, an abandoned leather satchel and a coil of rope on the stones for scale. Two wings, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long, a young dragon). SOLO. A blue dragon wyrmling bursts up out of a desert sand dune at night, sand cascading off its glossy cobalt-blue scales, a single stubby horn on its snout and a ridged frill behind the jaw, two small wings half spread and a long tail whipping behind. It spits a crackling line of lightning from its open mouth toward the right, which strikes a half-buried clay jar and fuses the sand into glass. Setting: moonlit dunes with a broken caravan wheel and scattered coins for scale. Four legs, two wings, one head.

LARGE (bull-shaped, about 2.5 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A brazen gorgon, a massive bull-like construct of riveted bronze and brass plates with two forward-curving horns, glowing furnace-orange light seeping through the seams and from its eyes and nostrils, and four heavy hooved legs, lowers its head and begins a smelting charge across a scorched courtyard, its hooves leaving molten tracks and heat shimmer rolling off it. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind dives aside out of its path, shield raised. Setting: a ruined foundry temple with broken pillars and smoke. Four legs, one head, two horns. SCALE CHECK: its shoulder is about one and a half times as high as the adventurer.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A cultist hierophant, a gaunt middle-aged half-elf man with a shaved head and pale tattooed-looking scars, in flowing white and pale-gold robes with a high collar and a gilded sunburst mask pushed up on his brow, stands on a ruined hilltop altar under a storm and calls down a storm of radiance: columns of searing white light fall from the clouds onto the stones around him toward the right. A curved pact blade glowing with pale light hangs from his other hand. Setting: a circle of toppled standing stones, kneeling robed acolytes in silhouette behind him. Original person. Two arms, two legs.

HUGE (about 6 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A cyclops oracle, an aged giant with weathered olive skin, a single large eye in the middle of its forehead now glowing with prophetic white-gold light, a long gray beard, wrapped in a patched woven shawl with bone charms and leaning on a knotted tree-trunk staff, sits up from a cave mouth on a sea cliff and unleashes a Flash of Light from its eye, a wide blinding beam sweeping over the waves toward the right. Two adventurers seen from behind stand on the rocky path at the lower right, shielding their eyes. Setting: a stormy Mediterranean-like island at dusk. Two arms, two legs, one eye. SCALE CHECK: the giant is only about three times as tall as the adventurers.

HUGE (about 4 m at the shoulder, a fey wolf). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A dire worg, an enormous wolf with shaggy black-violet fur, eerie pale-green glowing eyes, a long fanged muzzle dripping greenish poison and wisps of fey shadow trailing from its pelt, steps out of a shimmering rip in the air in a moonlit fey forest, head thrown back in a Dreadful Howl that sends rippling rings of sound through the mist toward the right. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right brace with spear and shield. Setting: twisted silver-barked trees and floating motes of light in the Shadowfell-touched Feywild. Four legs, one tail, one head. SCALE CHECK: its shoulder is about two and a half times as high as an adventurer.

LARGE (a heavy horse, about 1.8 m at the shoulder). SOLO. A huge draft horse with a dark bay coat, a long cream mane, heavy feathered hooves and a broad chest, rears up in alarm on a muddy farm road, forelegs kicking high, eyes white-rimmed and nostrils flared, a broken leather harness and snapped traces trailing from its collar toward the right. Setting: a rainy autumn evening beside an overturned hay wagon, a wooden fence and a farmhouse with a lit window for scale. Four legs, one head.

LARGE (wingspan about 5 m). SOLO. A giant bat with dark brown fur, huge leathery wings with visible finger bones, large pointed ears, a pug-like wrinkled snout and needle fangs, swoops out of a ruined bell tower at night, wings spread wide, mouth open in a shrill screech toward the right, with a cloud of ordinary small bats scattering around it. Setting: a crumbling chapel tower against a pale full moon, a cracked bronze bell hanging inside for scale. Two wings, two clawed feet, one head.

SMALL (about 1.5 m long). SOLO. A giant centipede with a glossy segmented body of dark red-brown chitin and yellow-banded legs, about twenty pairs of legs, long twitching antennae and large curved venomous forcipules, rears its front segments up off a dungeon floor and strikes toward the right. Setting: a damp crumbling dungeon corridor with puddles, a fallen torch still burning on the flagstones, a rusty helmet and scattered bones for scale.

LARGE (about 1.8 m at the shoulder). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A giant goat with shaggy white-and-gray fur, a long beard, amber eyes with horizontal pupils and two massive curling ridged horns, rears on a narrow mountain ledge, then lowers its horns to ram, kicking loose stones into the abyss. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind presses against the rock wall, hand on a sword hilt. Setting: high alpine crags above the clouds, bright cold morning light. Four legs, one head, two horns. SCALE CHECK: the goat's horned head is only slightly higher than the adventurer's head.

LARGE (wingspan about 6 m). SOLO. A giant owl with soft mottled brown, cream and silver feathers, a pale heart-shaped facial disk, two great luminous amber eyes and feathered ear tufts, glides silently through a moonlit old forest with wings fully spread, talons extended toward the right as it swoops past a lantern hanging from a branch; a faint shimmer of fey magic trails from its wingtips. Setting: ancient oaks, silver moonlight, mist, a wooden signpost below for scale. Two wings, two legs, one head.

HUGE (body ~8 m long with tentacles). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A giant squid with a long mottled red-brown mantle, two huge dark eyes, eight thick suckered arms and two longer feeding tentacles, rises from the night sea beside a small sailing ship, its tentacles coiling around the mast and rigging toward the right while a cloud of black ink spreads in the water below. Two sailors-adventurers seen from behind on the deck at the lower right raise a harpoon and a lantern. Setting: stormy dark sea, moonlight on the waves. SCALE CHECK: the squid's eye is about as large as an adventurer's head, its mantle about three times their height.

LARGE (wingspan about 5 m). SOLO. A giant vulture with ragged dark brown-black plumage, a bald wrinkled red-gray head, a cruel hooked beak and an unsettlingly intelligent gaze, lands with wings spread on a broken stone column in a desolate battlefield, hissing toward the right, while two more giant vultures circle in the hazy sky. Setting: a dusty canyon with abandoned shields, broken spears and a cart wheel on the ground for scale; harsh noon light. Two wings, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A githyanki warrior, a lean humanoid with mottled yellow skin, a narrow face, sunken dark eyes, long pointed ears and black hair tied in a high braid, wearing lacquered black-and-bronze plate armor with ridged pauldrons, rides on the back of a flying stone fragment and slashes with a shimmering translucent silver psi blade formed from pure thought, extended from one hand toward the right. Behind it the hull of a githyanki astral ship looms. Setting: a raid over a mountain town at sunset, the sky partly violet with astral mist. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A gladiator, a muscular broad-shouldered woman of mixed heritage with dark braided hair, a bronze half-helmet with cheek guards, a leather and bronze manica on one arm and a round bronze shield on the other, crouches in a dusty arena and thrusts a spear toward the right, mid-lunge, sand flying. Setting: a sunlit colosseum with tiered stone stands and a blurred cheering crowd, banners without writing. Original person. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (about 2.2 m tall). SOLO. A gnoll demoniac, a towering hyena-headed humanoid with patchy spotted fur, a wild dark mane, demon-touched curling horns sprouting from its skull and glowing sickly green eyes, wearing ragged hides hung with bone fetishes, raises one clawed hand to conjure the Hunger of Yeenoghu: a churning cube of utter darkness swallows the ruins to the right, while poisonous green fire flickers around its other fist. Setting: a burned village at dusk, smoke and red sky, a fallen signpost. Two arms, two legs, one head.

HUGE (about 5 m tall). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. A graveyard revenant, a hulking giant figure assembled from the dry contents of an old graveyard: grave soil, tangled roots, splintered coffin planks, rusted chains and bleached bones knit together into a massive humanoid body with two long arms and two legs, a skull-like head with burning cold blue eyes. It rises from a field of tilted tombstones in moonlight, one long arm sweeping toward the right as a wave of pale paralyzing light pulses from its eyes across the stones. Two adventurers seen from behind at the lower right raise a holy symbol and a sword. Eerie and dry, no gore. SCALE CHECK: it is only about three times as tall as the adventurers.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long, a young dragon). SOLO. A green dragon wyrmling, a young dragon with bright leaf-green scales, a small crest along its spine, a narrow jaw with a little frill and two small wings, creeps along a mossy branch hanging over a misty forest pond at dawn and exhales a cloud of greenish poison gas downward toward the right, wilting the reeds and lily pads. Setting: twisted willow trees, fog, a rowing boat and an oar for scale. Four legs, two wings, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A grimlock, a blind gray-skinned humanoid with rough scaly hide, empty sealed eye sockets, a mouth of jagged teeth, lank black hair and wiry muscular limbs in a ragged loincloth, drops from a cave ceiling crevice with a crude bone cudgel raised in one hand, head cocked as it listens. Below at the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind holds up a sputtering torch, unaware. Setting: a narrow Underdark tunnel with stalactites and dripping water. Two arms, two legs, no eyes.

LARGE (about 4.5 m long, 1.5 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A hippopotamus with massive gray-pink barrel body and thick skin, surges out of a muddy river with its enormous jaws gaping wide to show long curved tusks, water exploding around it. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind in a small reed canoe back-paddles hard. Setting: a tropical river at sunset with reeds, papyrus and egrets taking flight. Four legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: its open mouth reaches about one and a half times the seated adventurer's height.

LARGE (about 3 m, an invisible elemental). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. An invisible stalker, a creature of living air, shown only by what it disturbs: a roughly humanoid vortex of swirling wind, dust and torn leaves with the faint outline of a tall body, two long arms and a head, rushing down a narrow cobbled alley at night. Lanterns swing violently, papers and cloaks whip toward the right, a cart's canvas tears loose. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind holds a hat to their head and grips a dagger. Setting: rain-slick city alley in blue moonlight. SCALE CHECK: the vortex shape is about one and a half times the adventurer's height.

LARGE (about 3 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A lamia, a fiend with the upper body of a beautiful woman with dark curling hair, gold jewelry and a cruel smile, joined at the waist to the body of a great lion with tawny fur, four powerful clawed legs and a tufted tail, reclines atop a ruined desert temple stair and beckons toward the right with one hand while illusory golden light ripples around her. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind hesitates on the steps, sword half drawn. Setting: crumbling sandstone ruins at sunset, palms and heat haze. Two arms, four legs, one head. SCALE CHECK: she is about one and a half times the adventurer's height.

LARGE (about 2.5 m long). SOLO. A male lion with a thick dark golden mane, tawny coat and powerful shoulders bounds in a running leap from a rocky kopje, mouth open in a thunderous roar, claws extended, toward the right. Two lionesses stalk through the grass behind him. Setting: an African-like savanna at dusk with golden grass, acacia trees and dust in warm backlight; an abandoned spear and travel pack lie in the grass for scale. Four legs, one tail, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A merfolk skirmisher, a sea-folk warrior with the upper body of a lean person with blue-green skin, dark wet hair braided with shells, and the long scaled tail of a fish in teal and silver from the waist down, bursts from a breaking wave beside a reef and throws a coral-tipped ocean spear toward the right, water spraying from its fins. Setting: a sunlit tropical reef with turquoise water and a wrecked rowing boat for scale. Two arms, one fish tail, no legs.

SMALL (about 60 cm tall). SOLO. A close-up of a myconid sprout, a little mushroom-person with a pale cream stalk body, a small round speckled red-brown cap, stubby root-like feet and two thin arms, toddles across an Underdark cavern floor while puffing a soft glowing cloud of rapport spores from its gills toward the right. Setting: bioluminescent blue mushrooms, a dropped adventurer's lantern and a large boot print in the mud for scale. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A noble prodigy, a young elegant person of mixed heritage with tawny-brown skin, short dark curls and an amused, confident look, in a tailored midnight-blue doublet with silver embroidery and a short cape, stands on a palace ballroom floor and makes a graceful flick of the wrist: a shimmering violet psychic bolt arcs toward the right while a translucent hexagonal shield of force flickers up in front of them. A slender rapier hangs at the hip. Setting: a candle-lit hall with chandeliers and fleeing masked guests in the background. Original person. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (about 3 m tall). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A nycaloth, a hulking winged yugoloth with dark green leathery scaled skin, a gargoyle-like horned head with fangs, huge batlike wings, two long muscular arms with clawed hands and two clawed legs, hurls a large double-bladed greataxe that glows with silvery force toward the right, the axe spinning in the air above the rocks as it begins to return. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind braces behind a shield. Setting: the smoky volcanic slopes of Gehenna under a dim ash-gray sky. SCALE CHECK: it is about one and a half times the adventurer's height.

MEDIUM (about 2 m long with tail). SOLO. A black panther with a sleek glossy black coat showing faint rosettes, lean muscles and bright green eyes, crouches low on a thick jungle branch above a trail and then springs toward the right, claws out, mouth open in a snarl. Setting: a dark night jungle with moonlight through the canopy, hanging vines and a forgotten explorer's pack and machete on the trail below for scale. Four legs, one tail, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A pirate captain, a fierce woman with fair, lightly sun-tanned skin, long wavy auburn-red hair, gold hoop earrings, in a long red coat with gold trim, a white ruffled shirt, a dark tricorn hat with a large white-and-red ostrich plume, a brass-buckled bandolier, dark leather trousers and tall cuffed boots (the same person as the library icon), leaps freely from the rigging of a burning galleon down toward the deck, no rope, coat and hair flying, a rapier in her right hand and a smoking flintlock pistol in her left aimed toward the right at the sky. Setting: two ships locked in battle at sunset, cannon smoke, sails and splintered masts. Original person. Two arms, two legs.

TINY (rat-sized). SOLO. A close-up of a common rat with greasy gray-brown fur, beady red-black eyes, twitching whiskers and a long naked tail, perched on a stack of old leather-bound books on a cluttered cellar shelf, gnawing a candle stub and baring its yellow incisors toward the right. Setting: a dusty cellar with cobwebs, a burning tallow candle, a wheel of cheese and an iron key for scale. Four legs, one tail.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A satyr revelmaster, a fey with the muscular upper body of a red-bearded man in an open embroidered vest, large backswept ram horns wrapped in ivy, pointed ears, and the shaggy legs and cloven hooves of a goat, leaps high atop a wine-barrel table at a sunlit forest festival while playing a fiddle, a swirl of golden and rose-colored fey music rippling from the strings toward the right. Dancing fey revelers spin behind him. Setting: an afternoon meadow with lanterns, ribbons, spilled grapes. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A scout, a lean human woman with freckled skin, auburn hair in a tight braid and a mottled green hooded cloak over leather armor, kneels on a high rocky outcrop above a forest valley at dawn and draws a longbow toward the right, arrow nocked, a shortsword at her hip and a quiver on her back. Setting: misty pine valley, distant smoke of an enemy camp. Original person. Two arms, two legs.

TINY (about 30 cm long). SOLO. A close-up of a slaad tadpole, a squirming pale pink-red amphibian larva with a fat glistening body, a long whip-like tail, two tiny stubby legs and a disproportionately large mouth of needle teeth, wriggles out of a bubbling puddle on a cave floor and snaps toward the right. Several more tadpoles squirm in the murky water behind it. Setting: a chaotic Limbo-touched grotto with swirling colored mist, a dropped dagger and a cracked bowl for scale; no body horror.

SMALL (about 1 m tall). SOLO. A steam mephit, a small impish elemental with mottled gray-white skin, a body that blurs at the edges into hissing vapor, two small batlike wings, a pointed face with a sneer and clawed hands, hovers over a bubbling hot spring and exhales a scalding jet of white steam toward the right, fogging a copper kettle on the rocks. Setting: a volcanic geyser field at dawn, mineral terraces, a wooden bucket for scale. Two arms, two legs, two wings.

LARGE (a mob of small demons covering about 3 m). SOLO. A swarm of dretches, a scrambling heap of a dozen small pot-bellied demons with flabby sickly gray-green skin, spindly limbs, sloping heads with wide drooling mouths and tiny dull eyes, tumbling over one another as they surge toward the right across a muddy Abyssal plain, a haze of fetid greenish vapor rising from the mass. Setting: the Abyss under a bruised purple sky, broken spikes of rock; each dretch has two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering about 2 m). SOLO. A swarm of insects, a dense buzzing cloud of hundreds of beetles, wasps and biting flies, black and amber, pours out of a hollow dead tree and spirals across a marsh path toward the right, crawling over a dropped shield and a fallen lantern in a writhing living carpet. Setting: a humid swamp at dusk with sickly yellow light, reeds and cypress knees.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering about 2 m). SOLO. A swarm of stirges, a whirling mass of a dozen crow-sized bat-winged creatures with rust-red mosquito-like bodies, four small clawed legs and long needle-like proboscises, pours out of a ruined well at night in a spiraling column and streaks toward the right over an abandoned village square. Setting: moonlit ruined houses, a broken bucket and wagon for scale; each stirge has two wings and four legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A vampire nightbringer, a gaunt pale undead with gray-white skin, black veins, burning red eyes and sharp fangs, wrapped in a tattered black hooded coat whose edges dissolve into living shadow, glides out of the darkness of a narrow alley, its clawed hand trailing frost-cold black shadow tendrils that reach toward the right. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind lifts a lantern whose light barely holds the shadows back. Setting: a foggy old city street at midnight with a lit doorway. Two arms, two legs, no wings.

MEDIUM (wingspan about 1.8 m). SOLO. A vulture with dusty dark brown plumage, a ruff of pale feathers at its neck, a bare wrinkled pinkish head and a hooked beak, lands with wings half spread on the bleached skull of a long-dead ox in a desert, hissing toward the right as two more vultures wait on a dead tree. Setting: cracked desert floor at harsh noon, a cast-off waterskin and a broken arrow nearby for scale. Two wings, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A warrior commander, a broad-shouldered dwarf woman with auburn braids, a scarred brow and a determined shout, in battered steel plate with a dark green tabard and a crested helm, charges across a muddy battlefield at the head of her soldiers, holding a greatsword in both hands raised high toward the right, a longbow slung across her back. Behind her, banners without symbols and soldiers in formation follow through the rain. Original person. Two arms, two legs.

LARGE (body about 5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young black dragon with glossy black scales, a gaunt skull-like head, two forward-curving horns, a long tail and two leathery wings, lurks half-submerged among the flooded ruins of a sunken temple and rears up, spitting a line of hissing acid toward the right onto a mossy stone statue, which smokes and dissolves. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind wades knee-deep, sword ready. Setting: a dim mangrove swamp at dusk with hanging moss. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: its raised head is about one and a half times as high as the adventurer.

LARGE (body about 5 m long). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. A young green dragon with emerald scales, a tall crest running from its head down its spine, a narrow frilled jaw and two wings half spread, perches on a fallen elven archway in a sunlit birch forest in autumn and exhales a billowing cloud of poison gas toward the right that withers the golden leaves on the forest floor. At the lower right edge a single adventurer seen from behind has their cloak pulled up over mouth and nose like a mask and holds a longbow at the ready with both hands, an arrow nocked, aimed at the dragon. Setting: autumn forest, ruined elven stonework. Four legs, two wings, one head. SCALE CHECK: its raised head is about one and a half times as high as the adventurer.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. A yuan-ti infiltrator, a nearly human-looking figure with patches of fine green-and-bronze scales on the cheeks and hands, slit-pupiled yellow eyes and a forked tongue, wearing a hooded merchant's cloak over light leather, steps out of a crowded market alley at dusk, a curved scimitar half drawn in one hand and a thin green poisonous ray beginning to stream from the other toward the right, hitting a stack of clay jars. Setting: a sun-baked jungle-edge trade city with awnings and lanterns. Two arms, two legs, one head.

MEDIUM (human). SOLO. In a torch-lit underground shrine, a cultist of Demogorgon steps forward out of a ring of guttering candles: an original figure in a dark ragged hooded robe, wearing a monstrous carved two-faced mask (two snarling baboon-like faces side by side, no symbols) and long sleeves ending in limp fabric tentacles that sway like living limbs. He raises a curved iron ritual sickle high in one hand toward the right, the other hand spread in a summoning gesture, while thin necrotic purple smoke curls from the blade. Two more masked cultists chant in the gloom behind. Setting: rough stone walls, dripping water, a crude stone altar. Two arms, two legs, one mask with two faces.

TINY (a rat about 25 cm long plus tail). SOLO. Close-up on a muddy village alley at dusk: a sickly corrupted rat with a mottled, scabby gray hide through which its organs glow a bubbling toxic green, as if ready to pop, scurries out of a cracked clay drainpipe toward the right, beady red eyes gleaming. Clear scale cues: cobblestones, a dropped wooden spoon, a single apple and a boot at the lower right edge. Four legs, one tail, no other rats in front.

SMALL (dog-sized, about 70 cm long plus tail). SOLO. In a dim farm barn, a bloated giant corrupted rat with a ghastly mottled hide pockmarked by glowing green pustules bursts out of a torn grain sack toward the right, caustic yellow-green drool dripping from its long chattering incisors and sizzling on the straw. Clear scale cues: a wooden milking stool, a hay fork leaning on a post, a lantern on a barrel. Setting: dusty shafts of evening light through the barn boards. Four legs, one tail.

MEDIUM (a swarm covering a large area). SOLO. A squeaking tide of dozens of mottled, sickly rats pours out of a broken sewer grate and floods across wet cobblestones toward the right, climbing over each other; their scabby hides glow from within with bubbling toxic green light, lighting the tunnel walls an eerie green. Setting: a dark village sewer tunnel with a dropped lantern and an abandoned boot for scale.

TINY (about 60 cm tall, smaller than a cat). SOLO. On a cluttered tavern table at night, an imp trickster perches on an overturned tankard: a tiny red-skinned devil with small curved horns, pointed ears, sly yellow eyes, two bat wings and a long barbed scorpion tail. Grinning with petty malice, it flicks a stolen gold coin into the air with one clawed hand while the edge of its body shimmers and fades into invisibility; on the table beside it a black rat and a raven feather hint at its shape-shifting. Clear scale cues: a burning candle as tall as the imp, playing cards scattered face down, a tankard. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one tail.

SMALL (about the size of a large dog). SOLO. In a misty dark forest at night, a demodog lunges out of the undergrowth toward the right: a lean, hairless, four-legged predator with tough, wrinkled gray-brown hide and long sinewy legs, its faceless bulbous head split open like a flower into five glistening fleshy petals lined with small teeth around powerful jaws. Two more demodogs prowl in the fog behind it. Clear scale cues: fallen logs, ferns and a broken fence post. Flickering cold light in the mist. Four legs, one head, no eyes.

TINY (wingspan about 1 m). SOLO. A flock of demobats swoops through a ruined stone archway at twilight; the nearest one, in the center-right, dives toward the viewer: a slimy bat-like fiend with leathery gray wings, an eyeless head opened wide into a round toothed maw, and four long serrated tentacles trailing behind it in flight. The others are dark silhouettes against a sickly red sky. Clear scale cues: a crumbling archway, a hanging lantern and a weathered tree branch. Two wings, four tentacles, no eyes.

MEDIUM (about 2 m tall, slightly taller than a person). WITH ONE ADVENTURER. In a dark abandoned house hallway, a Demogorgon spawn stalks forward out of shadow toward the viewer: a lean, bipedal fiend with slick gray-brown skin, long thin limbs and long clawed fingers, its bulbous featureless head opening like a flower in bloom into five toothed fleshy petals around a gaping maw. The wall lamps flicker wildly around it. At the lower right, a single adventurer seen from behind raises a lantern and a short sword, standing on the same floor at the same depth; the spawn is only slightly taller than the adventurer. Two arms, two legs, one head.

HUGE (body about 12 m long; each head as large as a horse). WITH ADVENTURERS for scale. In an infernal arena under a smoky red sky, a demodragon rears up: a black-scaled dragon-bodied abomination with monstrous tattered wings, three writhing tails and TWO long necks, each ending in a bulbous head that unfurls into a flower-like arrangement of glistening fleshy petals and teeth around crushing jaws. One head looses a deluge of green acid down onto the cracked stone floor to the left of the adventurers, which smokes and melts. At the lower right, two adventurers seen from behind stand their ground on the same floor (a fighter with a shield and an elf with a bow); the demodragon's shoulder is about three times their height. Two heads, two wings, four legs, three tails.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. On a torch-lit stage of an infernal music hall, Dardew the Banished, a devilishly charming cambion showman with red skin, small swept-back horns, slicked-back black hair, leathery wings spread wide and a flamboyant crimson stage coat, strikes a power chord on a dark wicked lute; a shockwave of orange sound and sparks blasts off the strings toward the right across the empty stage. Flames curl around his clawed free hand, and a crowd of shadowy fiendish silhouettes cheers in the smoky background. Two arms, two legs, two wings, one lute held firmly.

SMALL (gnome, about 1 m tall). SOLO. In a candle-lit dungeon treasure chamber, Flizzlebin the Vanishing Gnome, a mischievous gnome with a long nose, twinkling eyes and a grin, wearing a tall floppy felt hat and a patched colorful coat, leaps off a treasure chest and flings a handful of dazzling glittering confetti toward the right, while his legs already fade into shimmering invisibility. Clear scale cues: a treasure chest as tall as his waist, a doorway, scattered coins. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (elf). SOLO. In a dripping sewer junction lit by sickly green light, Korex, a gaunt former elf adventurer warped by rat magic, with twitching whiskers, sharp rodent incisors, mottled gray skin and long pointed ears, in a ragged sewer-stained cloak, plays crude bone panpipes; waves of faint violet entrancing sound drift toward the right, and dozens of corrupted rats with glowing green pustules gather at his feet. A rusty knife hangs at his belt. Two arms, two legs.

SMALL (halfling, about 1 m tall). SOLO. On a blighted farm at dusk, Rilly June, a stern, hardworking halfling farmhand woman with sun-weathered skin and a straw hat, sleeves rolled up and patched overalls, plants her feet in the furrows and levels a pitchfork toward the right, ready to defend her grandfather's land. Around her, the crops are withered and twisted by a dark creeping blight; a loyal farm dog stands at her side. Clear scale cues: a wooden fence, a hay cart and a barn behind her. Two arms, two legs.

MEDIUM (human-sized). SOLO. On the edge of a blighted farm field, a vine blight tangler rises: a human-shaped figure wrapped entirely in twisting ivy and flowering kudzu vines, with a shadowy maw where a face should be. It thrusts one vine-arm toward the right, and grasping vines burst up out of the ground there in a circle, coiling around a scarecrow and a broken fence. Setting: withered cornstalks, a dim green twilight. Two vine-arms, two legs.
